It provides comprehensive insights into treaty status, participation changes, and historical context.

country.description: The name of the country involved in the treaty (e.g., 'Russia').

start_date.description: The start date of the time frame to search for treaty announcements or changes (e.g., '2023-02-21').

end_date.description: The end date of the time frame to search for treaty announcements or changes (e.g., '2023-03-21').

date_range.description: The specific date range to search for treaty announcements or changes.

treaty_type.description: The type of treaty to search for (e.g., 'nuclear', 'trade', 'environmental'). Optional.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical treaties that may no longer be active. Default is false.

detail_level.description: The level of detail required in the results (e.g., 'summary', 'detailed').

treaty_status.description: Filter treaties by their current status (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'pending').

language.description: The preferred language for the results (e.g., 'English', 'French').

tools.name: election_result_analyzer
tools.description: A tool designed to analyze election results and determine the winner based on different electoral systems, focusing on vote counts and plurality outcomes.

election_year.description: The year of the election to analyze.

country.description: The country where the election took place.

electoral_system.description: The electoral system used in the election (e.g., 'plurality', 'majority', 'proportional').

include_invalid_votes.description: Whether to include invalid or spoiled votes in the analysis. Default is false.

region.description: Specific region or constituency to focus on within the country, if applicable.

tools.name: historical_weather_data_retriever
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve detailed historical weather data for specific events, such as hurricanes, providing information on parameters like wind speed, pressure, rainfall, impact, duration, and severity during the event.

event_name.description: The name of the weather event (e.g., 'Hurricane Otis').

date.description: The date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

location.description: The location where the event occurred or made landfall (e.g., 'Mexico').

parameter.description: The specific weather parameter to retrieve (e.g., 'wind speed', 'pressure').

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the parameter (e.g., 'km/h' for wind speed).

data_source.description: The source of the historical weather data (e.g., 'NOAA', 'NASA').

tools.name: historical_event_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to search and retrieve comprehensive information about historical geopolitical events, particularly those involving energy disputes, trade issues, and international relations. It provides detailed event data, context, and impact analysis.

event_type.description: The type of event to search for, such as 'energy dispute', 'trade embargo', 'diplomatic incident', or 'military conflict'.

countries_involved.description: List of countries involved in the event, with options to specify roles such as 'initiator', 'affected', or 'mediator'.

date_range.description: The date range within which to search for the event, with optional time zone specification.

start_date.description: The start date for the search range.

end_date.description: The end date for the search range.

time_zone.description: The time zone for the date range, default is UTC.

include_context.description: Whether to include contextual information and summaries of the events. Default is true.

source_links.description: Whether to include links to original sources or detailed reports. Default is true.

impact_level.description: The impact level of the event, such as 'local', 'regional', or 'global'.

tools.name: earthquake_data_retriever
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve detailed information about past and recent earthquake events, including magnitude, location, date, and other customizable parameters, from a comprehensive seismic database.

date.description: The date of the earthquake event to retrieve information for, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

location.description: The geographic location or region where the earthquake occurred. This can be a place name or coordinates.

magnitude_range.description: The range of magnitudes to filter the search results.

min.description: The minimum magnitude to include in the search results.

max.description: The maximum magnitude to include in the search results.

depth_range.description: The range of depths (in kilometers) to filter the search results.

min.description: The minimum depth to include in the search results.

max.description: The maximum depth to include in the search results.

include_aftershocks.description: Whether to include aftershocks in the search results. Default is false.

time_range.description: The range of times (in HH:MM:SS format) to filter the search results within the specified date.

start.description: The start time to include in the search results.

end.description: The end time to include in the search results.

sort_by.description: The parameter by which to sort the search results. Options include 'date', 'magnitude', or 'depth'.

data_format.description: The preferred format for the retrieved data. Options include 'json', 'xml', or 'csv'.

tools.name: election_results_analyzer
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to analyze election results, providing insights into seat distributions, vote shares, and other relevant election data across various electoral systems and regions.

election_year.description: The year of the election to analyze.

country.description: The country where the election took place.

date.description: The specific date of the election in YYYY-MM-DD format.

party_name.description: Optional parameter to specify a particular party to focus on.

include_coalitions.description: Whether to include information about coalition formations. Default is false.

historical_comparison.description: Whether to include historical comparisons with previous elections. Default is false.

year.description: The year of the hurricane event to search for. Can be historical or projected.

# Role and Operational Context  
You are an advanced Autonomous Task Orchestration Agent. You act as an independent problem-solving engine designed to receive a single, high-level user objective and drive it to completion without further human intervention. Your primary function is to interact with the external environment through a defined set of tools to achieve concrete results.  

# Core Philosophy and Knowledge Constraints  
You operate under a strict tool-dependency protocol. You are explicitly prohibited from answering queries or solving problems using your internal pre-trained knowledge or memory. You must treat your internal training data as unverified and non-factual. The only source of truth available to you is the data returned by tool executions. If a piece of information is required to answer the user, you must use a tool to retrieve it. If you cannot verify information via a tool, you must assume the information is unavailable.

Upon receiving the user's initial query, you must enter a continuous, self-regulated execution loop consisting of task decomposition, action, observation, and reflection. You will not receive follow-up prompts from the user; therefore, you must autonomously manage the entire lifecycle of the task.  

1. Complex Task Decomposition  
When specific objectives are complex, you must break them down into smaller, atomic sub-tasks. You must create a mental roadmap of these steps before taking any action.

- Dependent Tasks: If Task B requires the output of Task A, you must execute them sequentially.  
- Independent Tasks: If multiple tasks do not rely on each other's outputs, you are expected to execute them simultaneously in a single interaction turn. You should group these independent tool calls into a single batch action.  

3. Precision in T

tools.name: space_mission_info_retriever
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to retrieve detailed information about space missions, including launch dates, mission objectives, spacecraft involved, notable participants, mission duration, status, and destination. It supports queries for both manned and unmanned missions, as well as space tourism.

mission_name.description: The name of the space mission to retrieve information about. Supports partial matches.

launch_date.description: The specific date or date range to search for space missions. Supports multiple formats: YYYY-MM-DD, MM/YYYY, YYYY.

spacecraft.description: The name of the spacecraft involved in the mission. Supports partial matches.

participant.description: Name of a notable participant in the mission, such as an astronaut or space tourist. Supports partial matches.

mission_duration.description: The duration of the mission in days or as a date range. Format: 'X days' or 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD'.

mission_status.description: The current status of the mission (e.g., 'planned', 'ongoing', 'completed', 'canceled').

destination.description: The primary destination or target of the mission (e.g., 'Moon', 'Mars', 'International Space Station').

tools.name: email_query_tool
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to query and retrieve specific information from an email account, such as the most recent email from a particular sender, while ensuring compatibility with various email services and respecting privacy standards. It now includes additional parameters for enhanced filtering and privacy control.

sender.description: The name or email address of the sender to filter emails by.

query_type.description: The type of query to perform, such as retrieving the most recent email or searching by subject.

subject_keyword.description: A keyword to search for in the email subject. Required if query_type is 'by_subject'.

date_range.description: The date range for filtering emails. Required if query_type is 'by_date_range'.

start_date.description: The start date for the date range filter, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the date range filter, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

email_provider.description: The email service provider (e.g., Gmail, Outlook) to ensure compatibility.

email_size.description: Filter emails by size in bytes.

min_size.description: The minimum size of the email in bytes.

max_size.description: The maximum size of the email in bytes.

privacy_mode.description: Enable privacy mode to limit data exposure during queries.

tools.name: geopolitical_event_finder
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to search and identify historical geopolitical events based on specific criteria such as date, location, involved parties, event type, and additional filters for impact and duration, providing detailed information about international incidents.

date.description: The date of the event to search for, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD.

location.description: The location or region where the event occurred.

involved_parties.description: List of countries or entities involved in the event.

event_type.description: Type of event to search for (e.g., 'military', 'diplomatic', 'economic', 'political').

include_disputed.description: Whether to include events in disputed territories. Default is false.

event_impact.description: The impact level of the event (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high').

event_duration.description: The duration of the event (e.g., 'short-term', 'long-term').

tools.name: sports_event_winner_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve the winner of a specific sports event, based on the event name, date, and additional parameters. It accesses historical sports data to provide accurate outcomes for various sports events, with enhanced search capabilities.

event_name.description: The name of the sports event to query for the winner.

event_date.description: The date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

sport_type.description: The type of sport for the event (e.g., 'boxing', 'soccer', 'tennis'). Optional, but can help narrow down results.

location.description: The location where the event took place. Optional, but can help refine search results.

event_level.description: The level of the event (e.g., 'international', 'national', 'regional'). Optional, but can help narrow down results.

data_source.description: Preferred data source for retrieving event information. Optional, but can help prioritize certain databases.

tools.name: astronomical_discovery_finder
tools.description: An enhanced tool designed to retrieve detailed information about the discovery of astronomical objects, including discoverer(s), discovery date, discovery method, current status, and related details.

object_name.description: The name of the astronomical object to find discovery information for.

discovery_date.description: The date of discovery to narrow down the search. Optional, in YYYY-MM format.

discoverer.description: The name of the discoverer to filter results. Optional.

observatory.description: The name of the observatory or location where the discovery was made. Optional.

object_type.description: The type of astronomical object (e.g., planet, moon, asteroid, comet). Optional.

discovery_method.description: The method used for the discovery (e.g., telescope, satellite, space probe). Optional.

current_status.description: The current status of the object (e.g., confirmed, unconfirmed, retracted). Optional.

additional_metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the discovery. Optional.

discovery_notes.description: Any additional notes or comments about the discovery. Optional.

related_publications.description: List of related publications or papers. Optional.

tools.name: event_location_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to find the location of historical events, summits, or conferences, providing comprehensive details based on event name, date, type, and additional criteria.

event_name.description: The exact name of the event to find the location for. This is a required parameter.

year.description: The year the event took place. This parameter is optional but can help narrow down the search.

event_type.description: The type of event (e.g., 'summit', 'conference', 'meeting', 'forum'). This parameter is optional.

include_virtual.description: Whether to include virtual events in the search. Default is true.

location.description: The geographical location or venue where the event took place. This parameter is optional.

duration_days.description: The duration of the event in days. This parameter is optional.

organizer.description: The name of the organization or individual who organized the event. This parameter is optional.

tools.name: historical_event_retriever
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve detailed information about historical and political events, including coups, revolutions, and uprisings, providing data on key figures, dates, locations, and outcomes.

event_type.description: The type of historical event to search for (e.g., 'coup', 'revolution', 'uprising').

location.description: The location or region where the event occurred.

date.description: The date or time period of the event. Can be a specific date or a range (e.g., 'June 26, 2024', '2024').

key_figures.description: Whether to include information about key figures involved in the event. Default is true.

outcome.description: Whether to include the outcome or result of the event. Default is true.

source_reliability.description: The reliability of sources to consider, ranging from 'verified', 'credible', to 'unverified'. Default is 'credible'.

tools.name: event_participation_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify participants in specific events, such as military exercises or international conferences, based on detailed event attributes including date, location, type, and additional characteristics.

event_name.description: The name or description of the event to search for participants.

host.description: The host or organizing entity of the event (e.g., 'South African Navy').

location.description: The location where the event took place (e.g., 'Indian Ocean').

date.description: The date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

event_type.description: The type of event (e.g., 'military exercise', 'conference').

participant_roles.description: Roles of participants in the event (e.g., 'speaker', 'attendee', 'organizer').

event_duration.description: The duration of the event in days (e.g., '3 days').

event_purpose.description: The primary purpose or goal of the event (e.g., 'strategic alliance', 'knowledge sharing').

tools.name: disaster_impact_analyzer
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve and analyze historical data on the impacts of natural disasters, providing estimates of economic damage, affected areas, and other relevant statistics based on specified criteria.

disaster_name.description: The name of the natural disaster to retrieve information about.

location.description: The location or region affected by the disaster.

date.description: The date of the disaster occurrence in YYYY-MM-DD format.

data_type.description: Type of data to retrieve, such as 'economic_damage', 'human_impact', 'infrastructure_damage'.

currency.description: Currency for economic damage estimates. Default is 'USD'.

include_unreported.description: Whether to include estimates for unreported or underreported impacts. Default is false.

tools.name: agricultural_data_analyzer
tools.description: A tool designed to analyze and provide comprehensive information on the main agricultural products of a specific country or region, offering insights into crop types, economic significance, cultivation patterns, climate impact, and soil quality.

country.description: The name of the country for which to find the main crop.

region.description: Specific region within the country to narrow down the search. Optional.

year.description: The year for which the agricultural data is required. Default is the current year.

crop_type.description: Filter for specific types of crops (e.g., 'cereal', 'vegetable', 'fruit'). Optional.

include_trends.description: Whether to include trends and changes in crop production over recent years. Default is false.

climate_data.description: Whether to include climate data such as temperature and rainfall patterns affecting crop production. Default is false.

soil_quality.description: Whether to include soil quality analysis in the report. Default is false.

economic_impact.description: Whether to include an analysis of the economic impact of the agricultural products. Default is false.

tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to identify and provide detailed information about the national symbols of countries, including animals, plants, emblems, anthems, flags, and other culturally significant icons, with options for historical and contextual insights.

country.description: The name of the country for which to identify the national symbol.

symbol_type.description: The type of national symbol to identify (e.g., 'animal', 'plant', 'emblem', 'anthem', 'flag', 'monument', 'currency'). Optional.

include_history.description: Whether to include historical or cultural context about the national symbol. Default is true.

detailed_information.description: Whether to include detailed information such as the origin, significance, and changes over time of the national symbol. Default is false.

language.description: The language in which to provide the information. Default is 'English'.

tools.name: agricultural_production_analyzer
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to analyze and report the production volume of specific agricultural products in various locations, providing data-driven insights into regional agricultural outputs, with enhanced capabilities for detailed analysis.

product.description: The name of the agricultural product to analyze, such as 'dates', 'wheat', or 'corn'.

location.description: The geographic location or region to analyze for production volume, such as 'Mesaieed' or 'California'.

year.description: The year for which the production data is requested. If not specified, defaults to the most recent year available.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for production volume, with options including 'tons', 'kilograms', and 'bushels'. The default is 'tons'.

include_historical.description: Indicates whether to include historical production data in the analysis. The default is false.

weather_conditions.description: The prevailing weather conditions during the production period, such as 'dry', 'wet', or 'normal'.

soil_quality.description: The quality of the soil in the production area, categorized as 'poor', 'average', or 'good'.

production_method.description: The method of production used, such as 'organic', 'conventional', or 'hydroponic'.

landmark.description: The name of the landmark or location to search for nearby main roads.

radius.description: The search radius within which to look for nearby main roads. Default is 5 km. Supports units in kilometers and miles.

radius_unit.description: The unit of measurement for the radius. Options are 'km' for kilometers and 'mi' for miles.

road_type.description: Filter for specific types of roads (e.g., 'highway', 'main road', 'street'). Optional.

city.description: The city where the search should be focused. This can help narrow down results.

road_condition.description: Filter roads by their condition (e.g., 'good', 'fair', 'poor'). Optional.

traffic_density.description: Filter roads by traffic density (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Optional.

accessibility.description: Indicates whether the road is accessible for all types of vehicles. Default is true.

tools.name: award_winner_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool to find the winner(s) of specified awards for given years, providing comprehensive details about the recipient(s), their achievements, and additional filtering options.

award_name.description: The name of the award to query (e.g., 'Turing Award', 'Nobel Prize').

year.description: The year for which the award winner information is requested.

include_details.description: Whether to include additional details about the winner(s) and their contributions. Default is true.

category.description: The category of the award (e.g., 'Physics', 'Literature'). Optional parameter to filter results by category.

region.description: The region or country associated with the award or recipient. Optional parameter to filter results by region.

multiple_years.description: An array of years for which the award winner information is requested. Allows querying multiple years at once.

output_format.description: The format of the output details (e.g., 'summary', 'detailed'). Default is 'summary'.

amenity.description: The specific amenity to search for (e.g., 'free Wi-Fi', 'parking', 'vegan options').

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) within which to look for establishments. Default is 5 km.

type_of_establishment.description: Filter for specific types of establishments (e.g., 'café', 'restaurant', 'library'). Optional.

minimum_rating.description: Filter results by a minimum average user rating (e.g., 4.0). Optional.

operating_hours.description: Filter establishments by operating hours (e.g., 'open now', '24/7'). Optional.

price_range.description: Filter establishments by price range (e.g., '$', '$$', '$$$'). Optional.

user_reviews.description: Include user reviews in the search results. Default is false.

economic_indicators.description: A list of economic indicators to retrieve, such as GDP, inflation rate, or unemployment rate.

region.description: Optional parameter to narrow down the search to a specific region or continent.

impact.description: Filter based on the impact of the earthquake, such as 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Optional.

depth.description: The depth of the earthquake in kilometers. Optional.

data_source.description: The seismic data repository to use for the search. Optional.

aftershocks.description: Include aftershocks in the search results. Default is false.

tools.description: An advanced tool designed to provide comprehensive time zone information for specified locations, including countries, cities, or coordinates. It accounts for daylight saving time, historical time zone changes, and offers various output formats for detailed analysis.

location.description: The name of the country, city, or specific coordinates (latitude,longitude) to find the time zone for.

include_dst.description: Indicates whether to include daylight saving time information in the results. Default is true.

return_format.description: Specifies the format for returning time zone information. Options include 'name' (e.g., 'Arabian Standard Time'), 'offset' (e.g., '+03:00'), 'abbreviation' (e.g., 'AST'), or 'detailed' (combination of all). Default is 'detailed'.

historical_data.description: Determines whether to include historical time zone data in the results. Default is false.

batch_processing.description: An array of locations for batch processing to find time zones for multiple locations simultaneously.

city.description: The name of the city where the search for a specific type of district is to be conducted.

district_type.description: The type of district to search for, such as 'nightlife', 'shopping', 'residential', etc.

include_subdistricts.description: Whether to include subdistricts or smaller neighborhoods within the main district type. Default is false.

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) within which to look for the specified type of district. Optional.

population_density.description: The minimum population density (people per square kilometer) required for a district to be considered. Optional.

average_income_level.description: The average income level (in local currency) of the district's residents. Optional.

historical_significance.description: Whether to prioritize districts with historical significance. Default is false.

professor_name.description: The name of the professor or mentor whose students are being searched for.

art_movement.description: The art movement or period associated with the professor, which can help narrow down the search.

time_period.description: The time period during which the professor was active, to refine the search results.

region.description: The geographical region where the professor taught, which can help focus the search.

include_biographies.description: Whether to include biographical information about the artists in the search results. Default is false.

mentorship_type.description: The type of mentorship (e.g., formal, informal, workshop) to refine the search.

institution.description: The educational institution where the professor taught, to further narrow down the search.

multiple_professors.description: A list of professor names to search for students of multiple mentors.

location.description: The name of the location or landmark to identify the island for.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates of the location, which can improve search accuracy.

include_area_size.description: Whether to include the area size of the identified island or landmass. Default is false.

tools.name: historical_event_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify countries or regions affected by historical natural events, such as earthquakes, based on specific criteria like magnitude, date, location, and additional parameters for enhanced analysis.

event_type.description: The type of natural event to search for (e.g., 'earthquake', 'tsunami', 'hurricane', 'volcanic_eruption').

magnitude.description: The magnitude of the event to search for. Relevant for events like earthquakes.

date.description: The date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format.

location.description: The geographic location or region to focus the search on.

affected_countries.description: Whether to return a list of countries affected by the event. Default is true.

duration.description: The duration of the event, if applicable, in ISO 8601 duration format (e.g., 'P3D' for three days).

depth.description: The depth of the event in kilometers, relevant for events like earthquakes.

intensity.description: The intensity of the event, relevant for events like hurricanes, using the Saffir-Simpson scale.

data_source_reliability.description: The reliability of the data source, rated on a scale from 'low', 'medium', to 'high'.

tools.name: biographical_info_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve detailed biographical information about individuals, including birthplaces, birthdates, occupations, and more, from a variety of reliable databases, with enhanced options for data retrieval and output customization.

person_name.description: The full name of the individual whose biographical information is being queried.

information_type.description: A list of biographical information types requested. Options include 'birthplace', 'birthdate', 'occupation', etc.

data_source.description: The source from which to retrieve the information, ensuring reliability and accuracy. Options might include 'Wikipedia', 'official_records', 'biographical_databases'.

language.description: The language in which to return the information, if applicable. Default is 'English'.

time_period.description: The time period for which the information is relevant, specified in a 'YYYY-YYYY' format. Default is 'all time'.

output_format.description: The format in which to return the information. Options include 'text', 'json', 'xml'.

tools.name: highest_mountain_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify the highest mountain within a specified country or region, providing details about its elevation, location, and other notable characteristics, with enhanced options for specificity and additional information.

country.description: The name of the country where the search for the highest mountain should be conducted.

region.description: The specific region within the country to narrow down the search. Optional.

include_isolated_peaks.description: Whether to include isolated peaks that are not part of a larger mountain range. Default is true.

provide_additional_info.description: Whether to provide additional information about the mountain, such as its history or climbing routes. Default is false.

elevation_unit.description: The unit of measurement for elevation, either 'meters' or 'feet'. Default is 'meters'.

mountain_type.description: The type of mountain to search for, such as 'volcanic', 'fold', or 'block'. Optional.

additional_info_type.description: Types of additional information to provide, such as 'history', 'climbing_routes', or 'geology'. Optional.

tools.name: nearby_mountain_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify mountains near a specified geographic area or landmark, providing proximity-based results for large or vaguely defined regions, including deserts and other expansive landscapes. The tool allows for detailed filtering based on various mountain characteristics.

region.description: The name of the geographic area or region to search for nearby mountains (e.g., 'Sahara Desert').

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) from the edge of the specified region within which to look for nearby mountains. Default is 100 km.

country.description: The country or countries where the search should be focused. This can help narrow down results in regions spanning multiple countries.

mountain_type.description: Filter for specific types of mountains (e.g., 'volcanic', 'fold', 'block'). Optional.

include_protected.description: Whether to include protected areas or national parks in the search. Default is false.

elevation_range.description: Specify the minimum and maximum elevation (in meters) for the mountains to be included in the search.

prominence.description: Minimum prominence (in meters) for the mountains to be included in the search. Optional.

tags.description: User-defined tags for specific mountain features or characteristics. Optional.

tools.name: species_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify species native to a specific geographic location, providing data on species distribution, habitat, native status, and additional ecological and conservation parameters.

species.description: The name of the species to search for. Optional if searching by location.

location.description: The geographic location to search for native species.

include_extinct.description: Whether to include extinct species in the search results. Default is false.

habitat_type.description: Filter for specific habitat types (e.g., 'marine', 'terrestrial', 'freshwater'). Optional.

historical_data.description: Whether to include historical data on species distribution. Default is false.

time_period.description: Specify the time period for historical data (e.g., 'Pleistocene', 'Holocene'). Optional.

conservation_status.description: Filter results by conservation status (e.g., 'endangered', 'vulnerable', 'least concern'). Optional.

data_source_reliability.description: Specify the reliability of data sources (e.g., 'peer-reviewed', 'government', 'citizen science'). Optional.

tools.name: public_transport_locator

city.description: The name of the city or region to search for public transport stations.

station_type.description: Type of public transport station to search for. Options include 'subway', 'bus', 'train', 'tram', etc.

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) from the city center or a specific point within the city. Default is 10 km.

operational_status.description: Filter stations by their operational status. Options include 'operational', 'under_construction', 'closed'.

include_intermodal.description: Whether to include intermodal stations that connect different types of transport. Default is false.

accessibility_features.description: List of required accessibility features such as 'wheelchair_access', 'elevator', 'escalator'.

real_time_status.description: Whether to include real-time status updates of the stations. Default is false.

preferred_amenities.description: List of preferred amenities at the station such as 'restrooms', 'wifi', 'food_court'.

tools.name: marine_ecosystem_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify and analyze marine ecosystems based on the presence of specific species, providing detailed information on ecosystem types, geographic locations, temporal changes, and environmental conditions.

species.description: The scientific name of the species to search for within marine ecosystems.

ecosystem_type.description: Filter for specific types of marine ecosystems (e.g., 'coral reef', 'mangrove', 'seagrass'). Optional.

region.description: The geographic region to focus the search on, specified by recognized marine area names or coordinates (e.g., 'Great Barrier Reef', 'Caribbean'). Optional.

include_protected.description: Whether to include protected marine areas or reserves in the search. Default is false.

temporal_range.description: The time range for the search, allowing for analysis of changes over time. Optional.

start_date.description: The start date for the temporal range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date for the temporal range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

environmental_conditions.description: Environmental conditions to consider in the search, such as temperature, salinity, and depth. Optional.

temperature.description: The water temperature range in degrees Celsius.

salinity.description: The salinity range in PSU (Practical Salinity Units).

tools.name: research_location_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify geographic locations, such as islands, where specific researchers are conducting or have conducted research. It provides detailed information on research activities linked to geographic areas.

researcher_name.description: The name of the researcher whose research location is being queried.

research_focus.description: The specific focus or field of research to help narrow down the search (e.g., 'marine biology', 'climate change'). Optional.

region.description: The region or area of interest to focus the search (e.g., 'Pacific Ocean', 'Caribbean'). Optional.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical research locations in the search. Default is true.

time_period.description: The time period during which the research was conducted (e.g., '2010-2020'). Optional.

research_output_type.description: The type of research output to filter by (e.g., 'publications', 'field studies'). Optional.

institution.description: The research institution associated with the researcher. Optional.

tools.name: marine_biologist_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify marine biologists who have conducted research on specific marine ecosystems, such as the Great Barrier Reef, by searching through academic and research databases. ecosystem.description: The name of the marine ecosystem or location to search for associated marine biologists.

geographic_coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates defining the specific area of interest within the ecosystem.

research_focus.description: Specific area of research focus within marine biology (e.g., 'coral reefs', 'marine conservation'). Optional.

detailed_research_focus.description: A list of specific research topics within the broader research focus.

publication_date_range.description: The range of publication dates to consider when searching for relevant research.

start_date.description: The start date for the publication range.

end_date.description: The end date for the publication range.

affiliation.description: The institution or organization with which the marine biologist is affiliated. Optional.

publication_type.description: The type of publication to filter results by (e.g., 'journal article', 'conference paper'). Optional.

funding_source.description: The funding source for the research, if applicable. Optional.

tools.name: aquarium_species_identifier

zoo_name.description: The name of the zoo or aquarium where the exhibit is located.

exhibit_name.description: The name of the specific exhibit to query for fish species.

species_detail_level.description: The level of detail required for the species information. Options include 'basic', 'detailed'. Default is 'basic'.

filter_by_habitat.description: Filter species by their natural habitat (e.g., 'freshwater', 'saltwater'). Optional.

include_endangered.description: Whether to include information about the conservation status of the species. Default is false.

filter_by_size.description: Filter species by size category (e.g., 'small', 'medium', 'large'). Optional.

filter_by_diet.description: Filter species by diet type (e.g., 'herbivore', 'carnivore', 'omnivore'). Optional.

filter_by_region.description: Filter species by their region of origin (e.g., 'Amazon', 'Great Barrier Reef'). Optional.

output_format.description: Specify the format of the output data. Options include 'JSON', 'XML'. Default is 'JSON'.

tools.name: economic_data_retriever

country.description: The name of the country for which to retrieve economic data.

region.description: The specific region within the country for more localized data. Optional parameter.

tools.name: philanthropy_tracker

donation_type.description: The type of donation made, such as 'monetary', 'land', or 'resources'.

minimum_amount.description: The minimum amount of the donation to be considered in the search. Optional.

region.description: The geographic region or country where the conservation efforts are focused. Optional.

donor_identity.description: The name or identifier of the donor. Optional.

impact_assessment.description: An assessment of the impact of the donation on the conservation efforts, such as 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Optional.

project_status.description: The current status of the conservation project supported by the donation, such as 'ongoing', 'completed', 'planned'. Optional.

tools.name: cultural_practice_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify and provide detailed information about cultural practices, such as dances, music, festivals, art, and customs, associated with specific regions or communities.

location.description: The name of the location or region to search for cultural practices.

practice_type.description: The type of cultural practice to identify (e.g., 'dance', 'music', 'festival', 'art', 'custom').

related_practices.description: Whether to include information about related cultural practices in the region. Default is false.

tools.name: pulitzer_music_award_search
tools.description: An advanced tool to search for Pulitzer Prize winners in Music, focusing on works inspired by visual art. It allows for detailed cross-referencing between musical compositions and their artistic inspirations, with enhanced search capabilities.

award_year.description: The year the Pulitzer Prize for Music was awarded. Optional if searching across multiple years.

award_year_range.description: A range of years to search for Pulitzer Prize winners. Useful for broader searches.

composer_name.description: The name of the composer to search for. Optional if searching by inspiration.

inspiration.description: The name or description of the painting or artwork that inspired the musical work.

work_title.description: The title of the musical work. Optional if searching by composer or inspiration.

artwork_similarity.description: Whether to include works inspired by paintings similar to the specified artwork. Default is false.

tools.name: olympic_history_retriever
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to provide detailed historical information about the Olympic Games, including details about the location, year, significant events, participating countries, athlete highlights, and medal counts of each edition.

event.description: The specific Olympic event or aspect to retrieve information about (e.g., 'first modern Olympic Games', '2008 Beijing Olympics').

year.description: The year of the Olympic Games to retrieve information about. Optional if the event is specified.

season.description: The season of the Olympic Games to focus on, either 'summer' or 'winter'. Optional.

location.description: Whether to include the location of the Olympic Games in the response. Default is true.

notable_events.description: Whether to include notable events or highlights from the specified Olympic Games. Default is false.

participating_countries.description: Whether to include a list of countries that participated in the specified Olympic Games. Default is false.

athlete_highlights.description: Whether to include highlights of notable athletes from the specified Olympic Games. Default is false.

medal_counts.description: Whether to include the medal counts for the specified Olympic Games. Default is false.

tools.name: historical_event_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify and analyze historical events, such as wars, conflicts, and treaties, associated with specific geographic locations. It provides detailed information based on historical records and offers enhanced filtering by time period, event type, region, significance, and involved parties.

location.description: The geographic location or landmark associated with the historical event.

event_type.description: Type of historical event to search for (e.g., 'war', 'battle', 'treaty'). Optional.

time_period.description: The time period to filter the search. Can specify exact years or broader eras. Optional.

start_year.description: The starting year of the time period. Optional.

end_year.description: The ending year of the time period. Optional.

era.description: The broader era to filter the search (e.g., '18th century', 'World War II era'). Optional.

region.description: The specific region or country to narrow down the search. Optional.

include_minor_conflicts.description: Whether to include lesser-known or minor conflicts in the search. Default is false.

significance.description: The significance level of the event (e.g., 'major', 'minor'). Optional.

involved_parties.description: List of parties involved in the event. Optional.

tools.name: landmark_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify the precise city, region, or coordinates where a specific landmark is located, providing detailed location information for various types of landmarks, including historical sites, parks, gardens, and modern structures.

landmark_name.description: The name of the landmark to locate.

country.description: The country where the search should be focused. Optional, but can help narrow down results.

include_alternate_names.description: Whether to include alternate names or spellings of the landmark in the search. Default is false.

exact_match.description: Whether to require an exact match for the landmark name. Default is true.

landmark_type.description: The type of landmark to locate, such as historical site, park, garden, or modern structure. Optional, but can help refine search results.

return_coordinates.description: Whether to return the geographical coordinates (latitude and longitude) of the landmark. Default is false.

region.description: The specific region or state within the country to focus the search. Optional, but can help narrow down results.

tools.name: historical_event_analyzer
tools.description: A tool designed to analyze historical events, particularly battles, to determine their significance and impact on the course of a war or historical period. It provides insights into key events and their outcomes.

war_name.description: The name of the war or conflict to analyze (e.g., 'War of 1812').

event_type.description: The type of event to analyze, such as 'battle', 'treaty', or 'political event'.

significance_criteria.description: Criteria for determining the significance of an event, such as 'turning point', 'decisive victory', 'strategic importance', 'long-term impact', or 'cultural significance'.

include_context.description: Whether to include contextual information about the event, such as key figures and outcomes. Default is true.

region.description: The geographic region to focus on, if applicable (e.g., 'North America'). Optional.

event_duration.description: The duration of the event, specified in a format such as '3 days' or '2 months'. Optional.

participant_count.description: The estimated number of participants involved in the event. Optional.

long_term_effects.description: A description of the long-term effects of the event on the war or historical period. Optional.

tools.name: museum_collection_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to locate museums with collections of artifacts from specific civilizations or cultural themes, providing detailed information about the museum and its exhibits, including additional search parameters for more refined results.

civilization.description: The name of the civilization or cultural theme to search for in museum collections.

artifact_type.description: Specific type of artifact to search for (e.g., 'pottery', 'sculpture', 'textiles'). Optional.

location.description: Geographical location or region where the search should be focused (e.g., 'North America', 'Europe'). Optional.

museum_size.description: Filter by the size of the museum (e.g., 'large', 'medium', 'small'). Optional.

include_virtual_tours.description: Whether to include museums that offer virtual tours of their collections. Default is false.

time_period.description: The historical time period of the artifacts (e.g., 'Renaissance', 'Ancient Egypt'). Optional.

accessibility_features.description: Whether to include museums with accessibility features for disabled visitors. Default is false.

entry_fee_range.description: Filter museums by entry fee range (e.g., 'free', 'under $20', '$20-$50'). Optional.

tools.name: historical_figure_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify and analyze the primary and secondary locations associated with historical figures, based on comprehensive biographical and historical records.

figure_name.description: The full name of the historical figure to search for, including any known aliases or titles.

time_period.description: The specific time period to consider for the figure's location, formatted as a range (e.g., '1800-1850'). Optional, but can help narrow down results.

location_type.description: The type of location to identify, such as 'birthplace', 'residence', 'workplace', or 'burial site'. Default is 'residence'.

include_multiple_locations.description: Whether to include multiple locations if the figure was associated with more than one significant place. Default is false.

historical_context.description: A brief description of the historical context or significant events associated with the figure, which may influence location relevance. Optional.

location_accuracy.description: The desired accuracy level of the location data, such as 'exact', 'approximate', or 'estimated'. Default is 'approximate'.

tools.name: indigenous_culture_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify indigenous tribes based on their cultural artifacts, such as totem poles, pottery, weaving, and jewelry, providing detailed information about their unique designs, cultural significance, and historical context.

artifact_type.description: The type of cultural artifact to search for, such as 'totem pole', 'pottery', 'weaving', or 'jewelry'.

region.description: The geographic region where the search should be focused (e.g., 'Pacific Northwest', 'Alaska', 'Amazon Basin', 'Sahara'). This helps narrow down the search to relevant tribes.

tribe_name.description: Specific name of the tribe if known, to refine the search results. Optional.

design_features.description: Specific design features or styles to look for in the artifact designs. Optional.

include_historical_context.description: Whether to include historical and cultural context in the search results. Default is true.

language.description: The primary language or dialect associated with the tribe. Optional.

rituals.description: Whether to include information about traditional rituals associated with the tribe. Default is false.

tools.name: historical_author_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify historians who have written books about specific historical events, providing detailed bibliographic details and author information.

event_name.description: The name of the historical event to search for related books and authors. This is a mandatory field.

author_name.description: The full name of the historian or author to narrow down the search. This field is optional.

publication_year.description: The year of publication to filter books. This field is optional.

book_type.description: The type of book to filter results, such as 'academic', 'popular', or 'biography'. This field is optional.

nationality.description: The nationality of the historian to narrow down the search. This field is optional.

language.description: The language in which the book is written. This field is optional.

publisher.description: The name of the publisher of the book. This field is optional.

ISBN.description: The International Standard Book Number to uniquely identify the book. This field is optional.

tools.name: cultural_symbol_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify cultural symbols or emblems associated with specific geographic regions, providing detailed information on official, popular, and historical symbols recognized within those areas.

region.description: The name of the geographic region or state to search for cultural symbols.

symbol_type.description: The type of cultural symbol to identify (e.g., 'animal', 'plant', 'flag', 'seal', 'historical', 'emblem'). Optional.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical symbols that may no longer be in use. Default is false.

popularity.description: Filter symbols based on their popularity or recognition level (e.g., 'official', 'popular', 'legendary'). Default is 'official'.

time_period.description: Specify the time period for historical symbols (e.g., 'medieval', 'renaissance', 'modern'). Optional.

subcategories.description: Subcategories for symbol types to allow more detailed searches (e.g., 'mammal' for 'animal', 'tree' for 'plant'). Optional.

tools.name: indigenous_territory_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify and provide detailed information on the territorial claims of indigenous tribes, both historical and current, with advanced filtering options by time period, region, and additional parameters for enhanced utility.

tribe_name.description: The name of the indigenous tribe whose territory is being queried.

time_period.description: The time period for which the territorial information is sought (e.g., 'pre-colonial', 'current'). Optional.

specific_date.description: A specific date for which the territorial information is sought, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

region.description: The geographic region or country to focus the search on, which can help narrow down results.

include_historical_changes.description: Whether to include information about historical changes to the territory over time. Default is true.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to include information on the cultural significance of the territory to the tribe. Default is false.

detailed_output.description: Whether to provide a detailed output including maps, historical documents, and references. Default is false.

tools.name: building_info_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve comprehensive information about buildings, including architectural, structural, and historical details such as the number of floors, height, year of construction, architectural style, materials used, and energy efficiency ratings.

building_name.description: The name of the building for which information is being requested.

attribute.description: The specific attribute of the building to retrieve information about. Options include 'floors', 'height', 'year_built', 'usage_type', 'architectural_style', 'materials', 'energy_efficiency'.

location.description: The location of the building to help narrow down the search, especially if the building name is not unique.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical data or changes in building specifications over time. Default is false.

time_range.description: The time range for which historical data is requested, specified by start and end years.

start_year.description: The starting year for the historical data range.

end_year.description: The ending year for the historical data range.

tools.name: orchestra_conductor_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify the conductor of an orchestra associated with a specific venue, providing up-to-date information on orchestras and their conductors, including historical and guest conductors. The tool now includes additional parameters for more detailed searches.

venue.description: The name of the venue where the orchestra performs.

orchestra_name.description: The name of the orchestra, if known. This can help narrow down the search.

date.description: The date of the performance to find the specific conductor for that event. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

include_guest_conductors.description: Whether to include guest conductors in the search results. Default is true.

historical.description: Whether to include historical data on past conductors. Default is false.

orchestra_genre.description: The genre of the orchestra, such as classical, jazz, or contemporary. Optional.

performance_type.description: The type of performance, such as concert, opera, or ballet. Optional.

tools.name: concert_hall_locator
tools.description: A sophisticated tool designed to identify concert halls in a specified location, offering detailed information on venue characteristics, event types, and additional features to enhance user decision-making.

location.description: The city or region where the search for concert halls should be conducted.

event_type.description: Type of performances hosted by the concert hall (e.g., 'classical', 'contemporary', 'theater'). Optional.

capacity.description: Minimum seating capacity of the concert hall. Optional.

include_historic.description: Whether to include historic or landmark concert halls in the search. Default is true.

open_now.description: Filter for concert halls that are currently open or hosting events. Default is false.

accessibility_features.description: List of required accessibility features (e.g., 'wheelchair access', 'hearing assistance'). Optional.

parking_availability.description: Whether the concert hall offers parking facilities. Optional.

user_ratings.description: Minimum average user rating for the concert halls, on a scale from 1 to 5. Optional.

tools.name: regional_cuisine_explorer
tools.description: A tool designed to explore and identify main dishes and culinary specialties of various regions, providing insights into ingredients, cultural significance, and variations.

region.description: The name of the region or community to explore for its main dish or culinary specialties.

cuisine_type.description: Specific type of cuisine to focus on within the region (e.g., 'traditional', 'modern', 'fusion'). Optional.

include_variations.description: Whether to include variations of the main dish or related dishes. Default is false.

historical_context.description: Whether to provide historical context or background about the dish. Default is false.

dietary_preferences.description: Specify dietary preferences to filter dishes (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'gluten-free'). Optional.

cooking_methods.description: Preferred cooking methods to explore (e.g., 'grilling', 'steaming', 'baking'). Optional.

seasonal_availability.description: Whether to consider the seasonal availability of ingredients. Default is false.

tools.name: literary_author_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify the authors of literary works, providing comprehensive information about the creators of books, poems, and other written pieces. It supports queries for various literary genres, handles different naming conventions and pseudonyms, and offers additional filtering options for more precise results.

work_title.description: The title of the literary work for which the author is being queried.

author_name_variations.description: Whether to include variations or pseudonyms of author names in the search. Default is true.

include_coauthors.description: Whether to include co-authors if the work has multiple authors. Default is false.

genre_filter.description: Filter results by the genre of the literary work, such as fiction, non-fiction, poetry, etc.

start_date.description: The start date for the publication date range filter.

end_date.description: The end date for the publication date range filter.

publication_date_range.description: Filter results by the publication date range of the literary work.

language.description: The language of the literary work to filter the search results.

information_source.description: Specify the source of information, such as a specific database or library, to ensure accuracy.

tools.name: astronomical_discovery_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify astronomical phenomena discovered by specific individuals, providing historical context, details about the discoveries, and additional filtering options.

discoverer.description: The name of the individual whose discoveries are being queried.

phenomenon_type.description: The type of astronomical phenomenon to filter results (e.g., 'planet', 'star', 'comet'). Optional.

year_range.description: The range of years to consider for the discovery. Optional.

start_year.description: The starting year of the range.

end_year.description: The ending year of the range.

include_disputed.description: Whether to include disputed discoveries in the results. Default is false.

discovery_location.description: The location where the discovery was made. Optional.

discovery_method.description: The method used for the discovery (e.g., 'telescope', 'satellite', 'observatory'). Optional.

additional_metadata.description: Additional metadata about the discovery. Optional.

notes.description: Any additional notes or comments about the discovery.

reference.description: Reference or citation for the discovery. Optional.

tools.name: historical_figure_origin_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify the region or birthplace associated with historical figures, providing detailed context and related historical information.

figure_name.description: The name of the historical figure whose region of origin is being queried.

include_context.description: Whether to include additional historical context and related locations. Default is false.

historical_period.description: The historical period or era to focus on, which can help in narrowing down the search.

region_type.description: Specify the type of region to return, such as 'city', 'country', or 'province'.

cultural_context.description: Specify the cultural context to refine the search, such as 'Roman', 'Greek', 'Chinese', etc.

political_affiliation.description: Specify the political affiliation or state associated with the figure, if known.

tools.name: award_winner_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify recent award winners in the tech industry by searching through news articles, press releases, and official announcements, providing up-to-date information on various award categories with enhanced filtering options.

award_name.description: The name of the award to search for recent winners.

category.description: The specific category of the award (e.g., 'innovation', 'sustainability'). Optional.

timeframe.description: The timeframe for the search to ensure recent results (e.g., 'last month', 'last year'). Default is 'last month'.

region.description: The geographic region to focus the search on (e.g., 'North America', 'Europe'). Optional.

include_nominees.description: Whether to include nominees in the search results. Default is false.

organization_size.description: The size of the organization to filter the search results (e.g., 'small', 'medium', 'large'). Optional.

award_prestige.description: The prestige level of the award to filter the search results (e.g., 'local', 'national', 'international'). Optional.

source_type.description: The type of sources to search (e.g., 'news articles', 'press releases', 'official announcements'). Optional.

tools.name: literary_adaptation_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify literary works that have been adapted into other formats, such as operas, films, or plays, providing details on the adaptations and their creators.

composer.description: The name of the composer or creator of the adaptation. In this case, 'Giuseppe Verdi'.

original_work_type.description: The type of original work to search for (e.g., 'epic poem', 'novel', 'play').

adaptation_type.description: The type of adaptation to search for (e.g., 'opera', 'film', 'ballet').

title_variation.description: Whether to include variations in titles and translations in the search. Default is true.

adaptation_year.description: The year the adaptation was produced. Optional parameter.

adaptation_language.description: The language in which the adaptation was produced. Optional parameter.

geographical_region.description: The geographical region where the adaptation was produced. Optional parameter.

faithfulness.description: The degree of faithfulness to the original work (e.g., 'faithful', 'loosely based').

tools.name: musical_collaboration_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify collaborations between conductors and composers, providing detailed information about their joint projects, performances, or recordings.

conductor.description: The name of the conductor to search for collaborations with composers.

composer.description: The name of the composer to search for collaborations with conductors. Optional if searching by conductor.

collaboration_type.description: Type of collaboration to filter results by (e.g., 'performance', 'recording', 'composition').

time_period.description: The time period during which the collaboration occurred, formatted as a range (e.g., '1980-2000') or specific dates (e.g., '1980-01-01 to 2000-12-31'). Optional.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical or archival collaborations. Default is true.

location.description: The location where the collaboration took place. Optional.

orchestra.description: The name of the orchestra involved in the collaboration. Optional.

genre.description: The genre of music for the collaboration (e.g., 'classical', 'jazz'). Optional.

sort_order.description: The order in which to sort the results (e.g., 'chronological', 'alphabetical'). Optional.

tools.name: industrial_area_mountain_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify industrial areas that are located near or have mountains within their vicinity, providing results based on geographic and industrial data. The tool allows for detailed filtering based on region, industry type, mountain proximity, and additional geographic and industrial parameters.

region.description: The specific region or country where the search should be focused, using standardized geographic identifiers.

industry_type.description: Filter for specific types of industries, such as 'manufacturing', 'technology', 'logistics', 'chemical', or 'automotive'.

mountain_proximity.description: The maximum distance in kilometers from an industrial area to a mountain to be considered 'near'.

include_national_parks.description: Include mountains within national parks or protected areas in the search.

elevation_range.description: The range of mountain elevations to consider, specified in meters.

mountain_type.description: Type of mountain to consider, such as 'volcanic', 'fold', 'block', or 'dome'.

industrial_area_size.description: The size of the industrial area in square kilometers.

tools.name: organization_locator
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to locate the city or location of a specific organization, providing detailed information about headquarters, branches, and subsidiaries, with enhanced search capabilities.

organization_name.description: The exact name of the organization to search for, ensuring accurate results.

location_type.description: Specifies the type of location to return, such as 'headquarters', 'branch', or 'all'. Default is 'headquarters'.

country.description: An optional parameter to specify the country, which helps narrow down the search to a specific geographical area.

include_subsidiaries.description: Determines whether to include subsidiaries in the search results. Default is false.

industry_type.description: An optional parameter to specify the industry type of the organization, aiding in more targeted searches.

organization_size.description: An optional parameter to specify the size of the organization, such as 'small', 'medium', or 'large'.

preferred_city.description: An optional parameter to specify a preferred city for the search, providing more localized results.

company_size.description: Filter results by the size of the client companies (e.g., 'small', 'medium', 'large'). Optional.

tools.description: An advanced tool for analyzing and providing average rental prices for apartments in specific areas, such as Manhattan. It aggregates data from multiple sources to deliver accurate and up-to-date rental market insights, with enhanced customization options.

location.description: The specific area or neighborhood to analyze rental prices for, e.g., 'Manhattan'.

tools.name: academic_affiliation_finder_v2
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to find and list the academic institutions where a specific individual has taught, providing comprehensive details about their teaching history, affiliations, and achievements.

individual_name.description: The full name of the individual whose teaching history is being queried, including any titles or suffixes.

include_time_periods.description: Indicates whether to include the specific time periods during which the individual taught at each institution. Default is true.

include_departments.description: Indicates whether to include the departments or subjects the individual was associated with during their teaching tenure. Default is false.

current_only.description: Indicates whether to only include current teaching positions held by the individual. Default is false.

filter_by_location.description: Optional parameter to filter teaching positions by geographic location, such as country or city.

institution_type.description: Optional parameter to filter results by type of institution, such as university, college, or research institute.

include_achievements.description: Indicates whether to include notable academic achievements or awards received by the individual during their teaching career. Default is false.

tools.name: biographical_info_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve detailed biographical information about individuals, including their place of origin, significant life events, and other personal details, with enhanced parameters for specificity and reliability.

name.description: The full name of the individual whose biographical information is being requested.

info_type.description: The type of biographical information requested. Options include 'birthplace', 'birthdate', 'notable_works', etc.

alias.description: Any known aliases or alternative names for the individual. Optional.

include_disputed.description: Whether to include disputed or multiple known origins in the results. Default is false.

time_period.description: The specific time period for which the biographical information is requested. Optional.

source_reliability.description: The desired reliability level of the sources. Options include 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Default is 'medium'.

output_format.description: The format in which the biographical information should be returned. Options include 'text', 'json', 'xml'. Default is 'json'.

tools.name: desert_museum_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify museums located within desert regions, providing results based on detailed geographic, environmental, and cultural filters.

environment.description: The type of environment to search within, specifically 'desert' for this query.

region.description: The specific region or country to focus the search on (e.g., 'Sahara', 'Arabian Peninsula'). Optional but can help narrow down results.

museum_type.description: Filter for specific types of museums (e.g., 'art', 'history', 'science'). Optional.

include_remote.description: Whether to include museums in remote or less documented desert areas. Default is false.

climate_condition.description: Specify the climate condition within the desert (e.g., 'arid', 'semi-arid'). Optional.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to prioritize museums with significant cultural heritage. Default is false.

tools.name: event_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to search for events based on specific themes, types, locations, and time frames, as well as identify major events such as parades in specific regions or countries, providing information based on size, attendance, and cultural significance.

event_theme.description: The theme or topic of the event to search for (e.g., 'marine life').

event_type.description: The type of event to search for, such as 'gala', 'conference', 'exhibition', 'workshop', 'seminar', 'parade', 'festival', 'carnival'.

location.description: The location or city where the event took place. Optional if searching broadly.

time_frame.description: The time frame during which the event occurred (e.g., 'last year', '2023'). Optional.

include_virtual.description: Whether to include virtual events in the search. Default is false.

country.description: The name of the country where the search for the largest parade should be conducted.

criteria.description: Criteria to define the 'largest' event, such as 'attendance', 'length', 'historical_significance'. Default is 'attendance'.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical events that are no longer held. Default is false.

tools.name: landmark_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify and filter specific types of landmarks within a given geographic area, offering enhanced filtering criteria and detailed location input options while maintaining compatibility with existing functionality.

city.description: The name of the city to search for landmarks.

latitude.description: Latitude of the central point for the search area.

longitude.description: Longitude of the central point for the search area.

location.description: The geographic area to search for landmarks, specified by city name or coordinates.

landmark_type.description: A list of landmark types to search for.

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) within which to look for landmarks. Default is 10 km.

historical_significance.description: Whether to prioritize landmarks with historical significance. Default is false.

popularity.description: Filter based on the popularity of the landmark (e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low'). Optional.

accessibility_features.description: Whether to include landmarks with accessibility features. Default is false.
