tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to locate specific types of establishments near a given landmark or location, providing proximity-based results for various regions and types of businesses or attractions. It offers advanced filtering options to enhance search precision and user experience.

landmark.description: The name or identifier of the landmark or location to search for nearby establishments. This should be a well-known place or address.

establishment_type.description: The category of establishment to search for, such as 'cinema', 'restaurant', 'hotel', 'museum', or 'park'.

radius.description: The search radius in kilometers within which to look for nearby establishments. The default value is 5 km, but can be adjusted to suit user needs.

region.description: The specific region or city where the search should be focused, allowing for more targeted results.

include_chains.description: A flag indicating whether to include chain establishments in the search results. The default setting is true.

rating_filter.description: Minimum average rating of establishments to be included in the search results, on a scale from 1 to 5. This helps in filtering higher-rated places.

opening_hours.description: The time range during which establishments should be open, formatted as 'HH:MM-HH:MM'. This allows users to find places that are open at specific times.

tools.name: culinary_origin_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify chefs, historical figures, or entities associated with the creation or popularization of specific dishes, providing insights into culinary history and origins.

dish_name.description: The name of the dish for which to find the associated chef or creator.

region.description: The region or country of origin to narrow down the search, if applicable.

time_period.description: The historical time period to consider for the dish's origin or popularization. Optional.

include_restaurants.description: Whether to include notable restaurants associated with the dish in the search results. Default is false.

ingredient_focus.description: Specific ingredients to focus on when identifying the dish's origin or creator. Optional.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to include information about the cultural significance of the dish. Default is false.

chef_biography.description: Whether to include a brief biography of the identified chef or creator. Default is false.

tools.name: advanced_calculator
tools.description: An enhanced tool for performing a wide range of arithmetic and mathematical operations, including basic arithmetic, exponentiation, and modulus, on numerical inputs.

operation.description: The mathematical operation to perform. Options include 'add', 'subtract', 'multiply', 'divide', 'exponentiate', 'modulus'.

number1.description: The first number in the operation.

number2.description: The second number in the operation. For 'exponentiate', this is the exponent; for 'modulus', this is the divisor.

precision.description: The number of decimal places to round the result to, applicable for operations that result in floating-point numbers.

handle_division_by_zero.description: Flag to indicate whether to handle division by zero gracefully by returning 'Infinity' or an error message.

tools.name: artwork_artist_locator
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to identify and provide detailed information about artists associated with specific artworks or locations, focusing on murals and other public art installations. It offers enhanced search capabilities through a variety of parameters.

location.description: The name of the location or venue to search for associated artworks and artists.

artwork_type.description: The type of artwork to search for, such as 'mural', 'sculpture', 'painting', or 'installation'. Default is 'mural'.

artist_name.description: Filter results by a specific artist's name. This parameter is optional.

art_style.description: Filter by specific art style or movement, such as 'modern', 'impressionist', 'abstract', 'classical', or 'contemporary'. This parameter is optional.

include_collaborations.description: Indicate whether to include artworks created through collaborations. Default is true.

date_range.description: Specify a date range to filter artworks by their creation date. This parameter is optional.

start_date.description: The start date of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

medium.description: Filter artworks by the medium used, such as 'oil', 'acrylic', 'digital', etc. This parameter is optional.

dimensions.description: Specify dimensions to filter artworks by size. This parameter is optional.

height.description: The height of the artwork in centimeters.

width.description: The width of the artwork in centimeters.

tools.name: age_calculator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to calculate the age of an individual at a specific event or date, accommodating various date formats, historical calendar adjustments, and additional temporal factors.

birth_date.description: The birth date of the individual in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

event_date.description: The date of the event in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ).

calendar_system.description: The calendar system used for the dates. Options include 'Gregorian', 'Julian', 'Hebrew', 'Islamic', etc. Default is 'Gregorian'.

time_zone.description: The time zone in which the dates are considered. Default is 'UTC'.

consider_leap_seconds.description: Whether to consider leap seconds in the age calculation. Default is false.

tools.name: population_data_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to fetch comprehensive population statistics for specified geographic locations, providing accurate, current, and detailed demographic data.

location.description: The name of the city, state, or country for which to retrieve population data.

location_type.description: The type of geographic entity (e.g., city, state, country).

year.description: The year for which the population data is requested. Default is the current year.

additional_info.description: Whether to include additional demographic information such as population density or growth rate. Default is false.

data_source.description: The source from which to retrieve the population data (e.g., 'census', 'world_bank').

data_format.description: The format in which to return the data (e.g., 'json', 'xml', 'csv').

name.description: The full name of the historical figure to retrieve information about.

info_type.description: The type of information to retrieve. Options include 'birthplace', 'birthdate', 'biography', 'achievements', 'historical_context'. Default is 'birthplace'.

include_context.description: Whether to include additional context or related historical information. Default is false.

time_period.description: Specify a time period to focus on specific events or achievements within the historical figure's life. Format should be 'YYYY-YYYY'. Optional parameter.

detailed_biography.description: Whether to provide a detailed biography including personal life, career, and impact. Default is false.

tools.name: population_estimator

location.description: The name of the city, region, or country for which to estimate the population.

year.description: The year for which the population estimate is needed. Default is the current year.

data_source.description: The preferred data source for population estimates (e.g., 'census', 'UN', 'World Bank'). Optional.

demographic_breakdown.description: Whether to include demographic breakdowns such as age and gender in the population data. Default is false.

data_accuracy.description: The level of accuracy required for the population data (e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low'). Optional.

visualization.description: Whether to provide a visual representation of the population data. Default is false.

tools.description: An advanced research tool designed to identify designers, engineers, or companies responsible for the creation of specific infrastructure projects, such as railways, bridges, roads, canals, and tunnels, by searching historical records and databases. infrastructure_type.description: Type of infrastructure to search for (e.g., 'railway', 'bridge', 'road', 'canal', 'tunnel').

location.description: The location or route of the infrastructure project (e.g., 'New York to Boston').

year_range.description: The time period during which the infrastructure was designed or constructed (e.g., '1800-1900'). Optional.

designer_type.description: Type of designer to search for (e.g., 'individual', 'company').

material_used.description: The primary material used in the construction of the infrastructure (e.g., 'steel', 'concrete', 'wood'). Optional.

historical_significance.description: Whether to include information about the historical significance of the infrastructure. Default is false.

project_cost_range.description: The estimated cost range of the project in historical currency values (e.g., '1000-5000'). Optional.

tools.name: biographical_info_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve detailed biographical information about historical figures, including birthplaces, birth dates, occupations, and other relevant details from comprehensive databases, with enhanced query options for specificity and accuracy.

person_name.description: The name of the individual whose biographical information is being sought.

info_type.description: The type of biographical information required (e.g., 'birthplace', 'birthdate', 'occupation').

include_sources.description: Whether to include sources or references for the information provided. Default is false.

time_period.description: The specific time period for which the biographical information is relevant, formatted as 'YYYY-YYYY'.

language.description: Preferred language for the retrieved information.

data_accuracy.description: The desired level of data accuracy, ranging from 'basic' to 'high'.

tools.name: geographical_feature_analyzer
tools.description: A tool designed to analyze and provide detailed information about geographical features such as rivers, mountains, and lakes, with capabilities to identify features based on specific criteria like length, height, or other advanced metrics.

feature_type.description: The type of geographical feature to analyze (e.g., 'river', 'mountain', 'lake').

region.description: The continent, country, or region to focus the analysis on (e.g., 'South America', 'Africa').

criteria.description: The criteria for analysis, such as 'longest', 'highest', 'largest'.

include_transboundary.description: Whether to include features that cross multiple countries or regions. Default is true.

elevation_range.description: The range of elevation to consider for mountain analysis.

flow_rate.description: The minimum flow rate in cubic meters per second to consider for river analysis.

temporal_analysis.description: Whether to include temporal analysis of changes over time. Default is false.

tools.name: explorer_discovery_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify explorers and their significant discoveries, particularly focusing on ocean currents and other geographical or navigational achievements.

discovery_type.description: The type of discovery to search for, such as 'ocean current', 'landmass', 'trade route', 'natural resource', 'climate pattern', 'cultural exchange'.

explorer_name.description: The name of the explorer, if known, to narrow down the search. Optional.

time_period.description: The historical time period during which the discovery was made, e.g., '15th century', 'Age of Discovery', or a specific range like '1400-1500'. Optional.

geographic_location.description: The geographic location related to the discovery, such as 'Atlantic Ocean', 'Pacific Ocean'. Optional.

include_minor_explorers.description: Whether to include lesser-known explorers in the search results. Default is false.

impact_level.description: The level of impact of the discovery, such as 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Optional.

source_reliability.description: The reliability of the source of information, such as 'verified', 'unverified', 'legend'. Optional.

tools.name: historical_residence_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve information about the residences of historical figures, providing details about locations and time periods associated with their lives.

person_name.description: The name of the historical figure whose residence information is being requested.

time_period.description: The specific time period or range to focus on for the residence information, if known. Optional.

include_multiple_residences.description: Whether to include information about multiple residences if the person lived in more than one location. Default is true.

provide_context.description: Whether to provide additional historical context about the residence and its significance. Default is true.

geographical_region.description: The geographical region to focus on for the residence information, if known. Optional.

residence_type.description: The type of residence (e.g., permanent, temporary) to focus on. Optional.

context_detail_level.description: The level of detail required in the historical context. Default is 'detailed'.

tools.name: cuisine_ingredient_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify staple ingredients used in various regional cuisines, providing detailed information on common ingredients, their culinary uses, seasonality, availability, and cultural significance.

cuisine.description: The name of the cuisine to search for staple ingredients (e.g., 'Mediterranean', 'Italian', 'Greek').

ingredient_type.description: Filter for specific types of ingredients (e.g., 'spices', 'grains', 'vegetables'). Optional.

region_specific.description: Whether to focus on region-specific variations within the cuisine. Default is false.

include_uses.description: Whether to include typical culinary uses of the ingredients. Default is true.

seasonality.description: The season(s) during which the ingredient is typically available. Optional.

availability.description: The general availability of the ingredient (e.g., 'common', 'rare', 'seasonal'). Optional.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to include information on the cultural significance of the ingredient. Default is false.

tools.name: restaurant_locator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to locate restaurants based on geographic location, offering comprehensive filtering options including cuisine, price range, ratings, dietary preferences, distance, and operational hours.

location.description: The geographic location or area to search for restaurants (e.g., 'Maui').

cuisine_type.description: Filter for specific types of cuisine (e.g., 'Italian', 'Japanese', 'Seafood'). Optional.

price_range.description: Filter by price range (e.g., '$', '$$', '$$$', '$$$$'). Optional.

rating.description: Minimum customer rating to filter results. Range is 1 to 5. Optional.

include_new_openings.description: Whether to include newly opened restaurants in the search. Default is true.

max_distance.description: Maximum distance from the specified location in kilometers. Optional.

operational_hours.description: Filter for restaurants open during specific hours (e.g., '09:00-17:00'). Optional.

tools.name: geographical_feature_associator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify geographical features associated with specific countries or regions, providing results based on national or regional significance, climate, historical importance, and biodiversity.

country.description: The name of the country for which to find associated geographical features.

feature_type.description: The type of geographical feature to search for (e.g., 'mountain', 'river', 'lake').

prominence.description: The level of prominence or significance of the feature (e.g., 'most famous', 'highest', 'largest', 'oldest', 'most visited', 'most endangered'). Optional.

region.description: Specific region within the country to narrow down the search. Optional.

climate_zone.description: The climate zone of the geographical feature (e.g., 'tropical', 'arid', 'temperate', 'polar'). Optional.

historical_significance.description: Indicates if the feature has historical significance. Optional.

biodiversity_index.description: A numerical index representing the biodiversity of the area. Optional.

tools.name: country_info_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve comprehensive geographical and statistical information about countries, including area, population, GDP, capital, currency, and additional metrics, with support for historical data and multi-country comparisons.

country_name.description: The name of the country for which information is being requested.

information_type.description: The type of information requested (e.g., 'area', 'population', 'GDP', 'capital', 'currency', 'population_density', 'life_expectancy'). Default is 'area'.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the area. Options include 'square_km', 'square_miles'. Default is 'square_km'.

historical_data.description: Whether to include historical data in the response. Default is false.

comparison_countries.description: A list of additional countries for comparison. If empty, no comparison is made.

year.description: The year for which the data is requested. If not specified, the current year is used.

tools.name: business_location_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to locate the operating address or location of a business or individual based on their name and other identifying details. It can search through business directories, historical records, and personal profiles.

name.description: The name of the individual or business to locate.

business_type.description: The type of business or operation (e.g., 'restaurant', 'cafe', 'pizzeria'). Optional but can help refine the search.

location_hint.description: A hint or known detail about the location (e.g., city, region, country) to narrow down the search. Optional.

historical_search.description: Indicates whether to include historical records in the search. Useful for historical figures. Default is false.

include_closed.description: Whether to include businesses that are no longer operational. Default is false.

industry_code.description: A standardized code representing the industry of the business (e.g., NAICS, SIC). Optional but can enhance search precision.

radius.description: The radius in kilometers within which to search for the business location. Optional.

start_date.description: The start date for the search range. Optional.

end_date.description: The end date for the search range. Optional.

date_range.description: The date range within which to search for the business location. Optional.

tools.name: desert_city_locator
tools.description: A sophisticated tool designed to identify and analyze cities located in desert regions near specific landmarks with notable architectural features. It provides results based on proximity, thematic relevance, and additional parameters for comprehensive analysis.

landmark.description: The name of the landmark or palace with unique architecture to search for nearby desert cities.

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) within which to look for nearby desert cities. Default is 100 km.

desert_region.description: The specific desert region or area where the search should be focused (e.g., 'Sahara', 'Arabian'). This can help narrow down results.

architecture_style.description: Filter for specific architectural styles of the landmark (e.g., 'Islamic', 'Modern', 'Ancient'). Optional.

include_historical.description: Whether to include historical cities or sites in the search. Default is true.

population_size.description: Minimum population size of the desert cities to be included in the search. Optional.

climate_conditions.description: Specific climate conditions to filter desert cities (e.g., 'arid', 'semi-arid'). Optional.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to prioritize cities with significant cultural heritage or events. Default is false.

tools.name: culinary_origin_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify chefs, historical figures, or entities associated with the creation or popularization of specific dishes, providing insights into culinary history and origins.

dish_name.description: The name of the dish for which to find the associated chef or creator.

region.description: The region or country of origin to narrow down the search, if applicable.

time_period.description: The historical time period to consider for the dish's origin or popularization. Optional.

include_restaurants.description: Whether to include notable restaurants associated with the dish in the search results. Default is false.

ingredient_focus.description: Specific ingredients to focus on when identifying the dish's origin or creator. Optional.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to include information about the cultural significance of the dish. Default is false.

chef_biography.description: Whether to include a brief biography of the identified chef or creator. Default is false.

tools.name: geographical_feature_info
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to provide comprehensive information about geographical features, including mountains, rivers, and other landmarks, with attributes like height, location, type, and more. It supports complex queries and multiple features.

feature_name.description: The name of the geographical feature to retrieve information about.

attribute.description: The specific attribute of the feature to retrieve (e.g., 'height', 'location', 'type', 'first_ascent', 'prominence', 'isolation'). Default is 'height'.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the attribute, if applicable (e.g., 'meters', 'feet', 'kilometers', 'miles'). Default is 'meters'.

include_related_info.description: Whether to include related information about the feature, such as historical or cultural significance. Default is false.

related_info_type.description: The type of related information to include, if 'include_related_info' is true (e.g., 'historical', 'cultural', 'ecological'). Default is 'historical'.

multiple_features.description: An array of feature names to retrieve information about multiple features simultaneously.

tools.name: culinary_dish_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify dishes based on specific ingredients, chef influence, and additional parameters, providing results from a comprehensive database of recipes and culinary experts.

ingredient.description: The main ingredient to search for in dishes.

chef.description: The name of the chef who popularized the dish. Optional if looking for general popularity.

cuisine_type.description: The type of cuisine to filter dishes by (e.g., 'Italian', 'Mediterranean'). Optional.

popularity_level.description: The level of popularity of the dish. Options include 'local', 'national', 'international'. Default is 'international'.

include_variations.description: Whether to include variations of the dish in the search. Default is true.

dietary_restrictions.description: List of dietary restrictions to consider (e.g., 'vegan', 'gluten-free'). Optional.

preparation_time.description: Maximum preparation time in minutes. Optional.

seasonal_availability.description: Seasonal availability of the dish. Options include 'spring', 'summer', 'autumn', 'winter'. Optional.

tools.name: regional_specialty_finder

leader_type.description: The type of leader to search for, such as 'emperor', 'king', 'pharaoh', 'sultan', or 'chieftain'.

infrastructure_type.description: The type of infrastructure associated with the leader, e.g., 'roads', 'bridges', 'canals', 'fortifications', 'aqueducts', 'palaces'.

historical_period.description: The historical period or era to narrow the search (e.g., 'Roman Empire', 'Ming Dynasty', 'Industrial Revolution').

region.description: The geographical region where the infrastructure was built (e.g., 'Europe', 'Asia', 'Middle East', 'Africa').

socio_economic_impact.description: The socio-economic impact of the infrastructure, such as 'economic growth', 'population displacement', 'cultural integration'.

road_name.description: The name of the historical road or structure to measure.

era.description: The historical era or period during which the road was constructed. This can help narrow down the search and ensure accuracy.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the road length. Options include 'km', 'miles', 'meters'. Default is 'km'.

city.description: The name of the city or location to search for nearby national parks.

radius.description: The search radius (in kilometers) within which to look for nearby national parks. Default is 100 km.

country.description: The country where the search should be focused. This can help narrow down results.

park_type.description: Filter for specific types of parks (e.g., 'wildlife', 'historical', 'recreational', 'mixed'). Optional.

accessibility_features.description: Whether to include parks with accessibility features for disabled visitors. Default is false.

   - For part (b): Use tools to identify the historical city, locate its cultural landmark, and retrieve venue information.  

3. **Precision in Tool Selection**: Ensure all tool parameters adhere strictly to their definitions

tools.name: historical_hemisphere_locator_v2
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to determine the hemisphere(s) where a historical figure lived, based on their known residences, life events, and additional contextual data.

person_name.description: The name of the historical figure whose hemisphere of residence is to be determined.

time_period.description: The specific time period to consider for the person's residence, formatted as a range (e.g., '1795-1821'). Optional.

include_multiple_locations.description: Whether to include all known locations if the person lived in multiple hemispheres. Default is true.

historical_context.description: Additional historical context or events that may influence the determination of hemispheres. Optional.

location_accuracy.description: The accuracy level of the location data, which can affect the determination of hemispheres. Default is 'medium'.

tools.name: historical_city_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify cities based on their historical, cultural, economic, political, and architectural significance during specific periods or movements such as the Renaissance.

historical_period.description: The historical period or movement to search for significant cities (e.g., 'Renaissance', 'Industrial Revolution').

region.description: The region or country to narrow down the search for historically significant cities. Optional.

cultural_significance.description: Whether to focus on cities with cultural significance during the specified period. Default is true.

economic_significance.description: Whether to include cities with economic significance during the specified period. Default is false.

political_significance.description: Whether to include cities with political significance during the specified period. Default is false.

architectural_significance.description: Whether to include cities with architectural significance during the specified period. Default is false.

population_size.description: The minimum population size of the city during the specified period to be considered significant. Optional.

tools.name: ethnic_group_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify the primary geographic locations of ethnic groups or tribes, providing insights into their historical and current distributions and cultural significance.

ethnic_group.description: The name of the ethnic group or tribe to locate.

historical_context.description: Whether to include historical context and changes in the group's location over time. Default is true.

current_distribution.description: Whether to focus on the current distribution of the ethnic group. Default is true.

region_focus.description: Specific region or country to focus the search on, if applicable (e.g., 'South Africa').

include_cultural_significance.description: Whether to include information about the cultural significance of the ethnic group in the specified location. Default is false.

time_period.description: Specific time period to focus on for historical context (e.g., '19th century', 'post-WWII').

data_source.description: Preferred data source for information (e.g., 'census data', 'anthropological studies').

location_granularity.description: Level of detail for location data (e.g., 'country', 'region', 'city').

cultural_aspects.description: Specific cultural aspects to include in the analysis.

tools.name: event_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to find events occurring in a specified location, providing results based on various criteria such as date, type, category, and additional filters like price range and audience type.

location.description: The name of the city or location where the search for events should be conducted.

date_range.description: The date range for which to search for events, formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD'. Optional.

event_type.description: Filter for specific types of events (e.g., 'concert', 'conference', 'festival'). Optional.

category.description: The category of events to search for (e.g., 'music', 'business', 'art'). Optional.

include_free.description: Whether to include free events in the search. Default is true.

price_range.description: The price range for events, formatted as 'min-max'. Optional.

event_duration.description: The duration of the event in hours. Optional.

audience_type.description: The intended audience for the event (e.g., 'adults', 'children', 'all ages'). Optional.

tools.name: event_attendance_tracker
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to retrieve, report, and analyze attendance figures for various events, offering detailed statistics based on event type, location, date, and additional parameters such as time and attendee demographics.

event_name.description: The name of the event for which attendance data is requested. Must be a non-empty string.

event_date.description: The date of the event in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional for recurring or multi-day events. Must follow the ISO 8601 date format.

location.description: The location or venue of the event. Optional but can help narrow down results for events held in multiple locations. Must be a valid location identifier.

include_estimates.description: Whether to include estimated attendance figures if actual numbers are unavailable. Default is true.

historical_data.description: Whether to include historical attendance data for past events. Default is false.

event_type.description: The type of event (e.g., conference, concert, sports). Optional but can provide more context for the attendance data.

event_time.description: The time of the event in HH:MM format. Optional but useful for events with multiple sessions. Must follow the 24-hour time format.

attendee_demographics.description: Demographic information of attendees, such as age group, gender, and region. Optional but can provide deeper insights into attendance patterns.

gender.description: The gender distribution of attendees (e.g., male, female, non-binary).

region.description: The geographical region of attendees (e.g., North America, Europe).

tools.name: capital_city_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to identify the capital city or cities of a specified country, providing detailed information on their roles, historical context, population, geographical coordinates, and administrative divisions.

country.description: The name of the country for which to find the capital city or cities.

include_roles.description: Whether to include the roles or functions of the capital cities, if applicable. Default is true.

historical_context.description: Whether to include historical context or changes in capital cities over time. Default is false.

population.description: Whether to include the population of the capital city or cities. Default is false.

geographical_coordinates.description: Whether to include the geographical coordinates (latitude and longitude) of the capital city or cities. Default is false.

administrative_divisions.description: Whether to include information about the administrative divisions or regions within which the capital city or cities are located. Default is false.

sort_by.description: Criteria to sort the capital cities, such as 'population' or 'historical_significance'. Default is 'name'.

tools.name: architect_info_retriever
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve detailed information about the architect or designer of a specific building or structure, providing comprehensive details about the design, construction, and the architect's other notable works.

building_name.description: The name of the building or structure to find the designer or architect for.

location.description: The location of the building to help narrow down the search, if necessary. Optional.

include_additional_info.description: Whether to include additional information about the architect, such as other works and architectural style. Default is true.

design_period.description: The period during which the building was designed, if known. Optional.

architectural_style.description: The architectural style of the building, if known. Optional.

materials_used.description: The primary materials used in the construction of the building, if known. Optional.

completion_date.description: The date when the building was completed, if known. Optional.

tools.name: venue_information_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve comprehensive information about various venues, including seating capacity, location, historical data, and event schedules. It supports detailed queries for theaters, concert halls, and other event spaces.

venue_name.description: The name of the venue for which information is being requested.

location.description: The location or city where the venue is situated. Optional but can help narrow down results.

information_type.description: The type of information requested about the venue. Options include 'capacity', 'location', 'history', 'events', 'facilities', 'accessibility', 'contact_info'.

configuration.description: The specific configuration of the venue if applicable (e.g., 'theater', 'concert', 'conference', 'exhibition', 'banquet'). Optional.

event_date.description: The date for which event information is requested. Optional but can help in retrieving date-specific events.

historical_data.description: Flag to indicate if historical data about the venue is requested. Default is false.

tools.name: historical_location_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to locate historical sites and places associated with significant figures and events, providing contextually relevant information based on historical records and data, with enhanced parameters for detailed search and analysis.

figure.description: The name of the historical figure whose teaching or activity location is being queried.

activity.description: The specific activity or event associated with the figure (e.g., 'teaching', 'birthplace', 'death').

time_period.description: The time period during which the activity took place, to narrow down the search (e.g., '4th century BC').

region.description: The geographical region associated with the figure or activity, to help focus the search (e.g., 'Ancient Greece').

source_reliability.description: The reliability of the historical sources used to locate the site (e.g., 'high', 'medium', 'low').

site_type.description: The type of historical site being searched for (e.g., 'archaeological', 'monument', 'museum').

cultural_significance.description: The cultural significance of the site, indicating its importance in historical context (e.g., 'world heritage', 'national landmark').

tools.name: tribal_language_identifier
tools.description: A sophisticated tool designed to identify tribes based on the unique languages they speak, offering comprehensive insights into language families, historical context, and sociolinguistic relationships.

language_family.description: The language family to which the unique language belongs (e.g., 'Indo-European', 'Sino-Tibetan', 'Afro-Asiatic'). Optional.

region.description: The geographical region where the tribe is located, with sub-regional details (e.g., 'West Africa', 'Amazon Basin'). Optional.

uniqueness_criteria.description: Criteria for determining the uniqueness of the language (e.g., 'endangered', 'isolated', 'creole', 'pidgin', 'revitalized'). Optional.

related_languages.description: Whether to include information about related languages and their speakers. Default is true.

historical_context.description: Historical context of the language's development and its influence on or from other languages. Optional.

language_vitality.description: The vitality status of the language (e.g., 'extinct', 'critically endangered', 'vulnerable', 'safe'). Optional.

sociolinguistic_factors.description: Sociolinguistic factors affecting the language (e.g., 'bilingualism', 'language shift', 'language maintenance'). Optional.

tools.name: cultural_landmark_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify famous cultural landmarks or venues within a specific city or region, providing detailed information on theaters, museums, and other points of interest based on their historical and cultural significance.

city.description: The name of the city where the search for famous cultural landmarks is to be conducted.

landmark_type.description: The type of cultural landmark to search for (e.g., 'theater', 'museum', 'gallery').

fame_criteria.description: Criteria for determining fame, such as 'historical', 'visitor_numbers', 'local_recognition'. Default is 'historical'.

include_modern.description: Whether to include modern venues or only historical ones. Default is true.

radius.description: The radius in kilometers within which to search for landmarks. Default is 10 km.

language.description: The language in which the information should be provided. Default is 'English'.

operating_hours.description: Filter landmarks based on whether they are currently open. Default is false.

region_hint.description: An optional hint for the region or area to help disambiguate locations with similar names.

include_alternate_names.description: Whether to consider alternate or historical names for the location. Default is true.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location for more precise identification.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location for more precise identification.

output_format.description: The desired format of the output, such as 'json' or 'xml'. Default is 'json'.

data_source_preference.description: Preferred data source for location information, such as 'official', 'community', or 'historical'. Default is 'official'.

operation.description: The arithmetic or mathematical operation to perform. Options include 'add', 'subtract', 'multiply', 'divide', 'power', 'sqrt', 'log', 'exp'.

operand1.description: The first number in the arithmetic operation. For operations like 'sqrt', this is the number to find the square root of.

operand2.description: The second number in the arithmetic operation. Not required for operations like 'sqrt'.

use_constants.description: Flag to indicate if mathematical constants like Pi or Euler's number should be used.

batch_operations.description: An array of operations to perform in sequence, allowing for batch processing.

tools.name: river_origin_locator
tools.description: A sophisticated tool designed to identify and analyze rivers based on their origin in mountain ranges, particularly those known for high biodiversity. It provides comprehensive information on river origins, mountain range characteristics, ecological significance, and additional hydrological and ecological parameters.

mountain_range.description: The name or specific characteristics of the mountain range to search for river origins, such as geological age or altitude range.

biodiversity_criteria.description: Objective criteria for biodiversity, such as 'high flora diversity', 'endemic species', or 'protected area'.

region.description: The specific geographic region to focus the search on, which can help narrow down results.

include_tributaries.description: Whether to include tributaries in the search results. Default is false.

ecological_significance.description: Whether to include detailed information on the ecological significance of the river and its origin. Default is true.

altitude_range.description: The altitude range of the mountain range to consider, specified as a minimum and maximum value (e.g., '1000-3000m').

river_length.description: The minimum length of the river in kilometers to be considered in the search.

biodiversity_index.description: A specific biodiversity index value to filter rivers, allowing for more precise ecological assessments.

tools.name: train_route_distance_calculator
tools.description: An advanced tool to calculate the distance covered by trains between two cities, accommodating different types of train services and routes, with additional parameters for enhanced route planning.

departure_city.description: The name of the city where the train journey begins.

arrival_city.description: The name of the city where the train journey ends.

route_preference.description: Preference for the type of train route (e.g., 'direct', 'scenic'). Default is 'direct'.

unit.description: Unit of distance to return. Can be 'km' or 'miles'. Default is 'km'.

intermediate_stops.description: List of intermediate stops along the route, if any.

estimated_travel_time.description: Estimated travel time for the journey, formatted as 'HH:MM'.

environmental_impact.description: Estimated environmental impact of the journey, categorized as 'low', 'medium', or 'high'.

include_history.description: Determines whether to include detailed historical context or background information about the airline's name. Default is false.

region.description: The specific region or country where the airline is based, which can help narrow down results to a particular geographic area.

alliance.description: The airline alliance the airline is a member of, if applicable, to identify partnerships and collaborations.

airline_name.description: The exact name of the airline for which to find connected cities.

include_codeshare.description: Indicates whether to include codeshare flights in the search. Default is true.

max_flight_duration.description: Maximum flight duration in hours. Optional.

include_layovers.description: Indicates whether to include routes with layovers. Default is false.

region.description: The geographical area where the discovery was made, e.g., 'Amazon Rainforest'.

historical_analysis.description: Whether to include historical data analysis in the identification process. Default is false.

future_projections.description: Whether to include future projections in the analysis. Default is false.

artwork_name.description: The exact name of the artwork for which metadata is being requested.

artist_name.description: The full name of the artist who created the artwork. Optional, but can help narrow down results.

end_date.description: The end date of the range in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.name: flight_distance_calculator

origin.description: The starting point for the distance calculation, specified as a city name, airport code, or geographic coordinates (latitude,longitude).

destination.description: The ending point for the distance calculation, specified as a city name, airport code, or geographic coordinates (latitude,longitude).

unit.description: Unit of distance to return. Options include 'km', 'miles', or 'nautical miles'. Default is 'km'.

consider_airspace_restrictions.description: Whether to consider airspace restrictions that might affect the flight path. Default is false.

weather_conditions.description: Weather conditions that might affect the flight path, such as 'clear', 'rain', 'storm'. Default is 'clear'.

flight_speed.description: Average speed of the flight in km/h. Default is 900 km/h.

layovers.description: List of layover locations specified as city names or airport codes, which can affect the total distance and time.

tools.name: cultural_landmark_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify countries or regions known for specific cultural or historical landmarks, such as castles, temples, or monuments. landmark_type.description: The type of cultural or historical landmark to search for (e.g., 'castles', 'temples', 'monuments').

time_period.description: Optional time period to filter landmarks by their era of significance (e.g., 'medieval', 'renaissance').

country.description: Optional specific country to narrow down the search.

landmark_size.description: Optional parameter to filter landmarks by size (e.g., 'small', 'medium', 'large').

visitor_statistics.description: Whether to include visitor statistics in the search results. Default is false.

tools.name: explorer_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify explorers based on their expeditions and regions they explored, providing historical context and details about their contributions.

region.description: The geographic region or landmark associated with the explorer's activities (e.g., 'Amazon River').

impact.description: The impact of the explorer's expeditions on the region or subsequent explorations.

resources_used.description: Resources or tools used during the exploration (e.g., 'compass', 'maps').

include_translations.description: Options for including translated editions of novels originally written in the specified language.

languages.description: Specific languages to include translations for, if 'include' is true.

literary_awards.description: A list of literary awards the novel has won. Optional parameter to narrow down the search.

designer.description: The name of the designer or architect whose significant works are being queried.

structure_type.description: The type of structure to search for (e.g., 'bridge', 'building', 'monument', 'railroad', 'tunnel'). Optional.

year_range.description: The range of years during which the structure was designed or built. Format: 'YYYY-YYYY'. Optional.

geographic_location.description: The geographic location where the structure is situated. Optional.

material_used.description: The primary material used in the construction of the structure (e.g., 'stone', 'steel', 'concrete'). Optional.

literary_work.description: The title of the literary work or subject to search for in university course offerings.

study_level.description: The level of study for the course, such as 'undergraduate' or 'graduate'. Optional.

language_of_instruction.description: The language in which the course is taught. Optional.

building_type.description: The type of building to search for (e.g., 'museum', 'library', 'residential'). Optional.

location.description: The location or region to narrow down the search (e.g., 'France', 'India'). Optional.

year_of_design.description: The year or range of years when the building was designed. Optional.

material_used.description: The primary material used in the construction of the building (e.g., 'concrete', 'steel', 'wood'). Optional.

project_status.description: The current status of the project (e.g., 'completed', 'under construction', 'planned'). Optional.

award_winning.description: Indicates whether the building has won any architectural awards. Optional.

country.description: The name of the country for which to identify the primary language(s).

include_official.description: Whether to include official languages in the results. Default is true.

language_prevalence.description: Filter languages by their prevalence in the population. Options are 'high', 'medium', or 'low'.

historical_context.description: Whether to include historical context of language development and changes. Default is false.

play_title.description: The title of the play for which the budget information is requested.

author.description: The author of the play, used to narrow down search results. In this case, 'Luigi Pirandello'.

production_year.description: The year of the production to find the specific budget. Optional, but can help refine the search.

currency.description: The currency in which the budget should be reported. Default is 'USD'.

location.description: The location or country of the production, which can affect budget details.

include_inflation_adjustment.description: Whether to adjust the budget for inflation to present-day values. Default is false.

tools.description: A tool designed to analyze and identify countries with the most Grand Slam winners in tennis, providing insights based on historical and current data across different tournaments, time periods, and player demographics.

tournament.description: The specific Grand Slam tournament to analyze (e.g., 'Wimbledon', 'US Open'). Optional, if omitted, considers all tournaments.

time_period.description: The time period for analysis, specified in a more granular format (e.g., 'all-time', 'last decade', '2000-2010'). Default is 'all-time'.

include_doubles.description: Whether to include doubles and mixed doubles winners in the analysis. Default is false.

nationality_changes.description: Consider players who have changed nationality during their career. Default is true.

player_gender.description: Filter analysis by player gender (e.g., 'male', 'female', 'all'). Default is 'all'.

output_format.description: Specify the format of the output data (e.g., 'json', 'csv'). Default is 'json'.

tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve comprehensive factual information about educational institutions, including founding years, historical events, notable figures, and more. institution_name.description: The name of the educational institution to retrieve information about.

fact_type.description: The type of factual information requested, such as 'founding_year', 'notable_alumni', 'historical_events', 'campus_size', 'student_population', 'academic_programs'.

additional_context.description: Whether to provide additional context or related information about the fact. Default is false.

time_period.description: Specify a time period for historical events or notable changes, formatted as 'YYYY-YYYY'. Optional parameter to refine the search.

location_details.description: Whether to include detailed location information such as city, state, and country. Default is false.

tools.name: elevation_finder
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to provide detailed elevation data for geographic features, supporting multiple units, data sources, and temporal analysis, while accommodating various naming conventions or coordinates.

feature_name.description: The name of the geographic feature for which to find the elevation.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) of the feature, if known.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the elevation. Options include 'meters', 'feet', 'kilometers', 'miles'. Default is 'meters'.

data_source.description: The source of the elevation data. Options include 'satellite', 'survey', 'LIDAR'. Default is 'satellite'.

accuracy.description: The accuracy level of the elevation data. Options include 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Default is 'medium'.

timestamp.description: The timestamp for the elevation data, allowing for temporal analysis. Format is 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

tools.name: literary_setting_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify the geographic and historical settings of literary works, providing detailed information about the locations and contexts in which these stories take place.

title.description: The title of the literary work for which the setting is to be identified.

author.description: The author of the literary work. This can help narrow down results if there are multiple works with similar titles.

language.description: The language in which the literary work is written or commonly known. This can assist in identifying the correct version or translation.

include_historical_context.description: Whether to include historical context or time period information about the setting. Default is false.

genre.description: The genre of the literary work, which can help refine the search for settings.

publication_year.description: The year the literary work was published, which can help in identifying the correct setting.

intended_audience.description: The intended audience of the literary work, such as children, young adults, or adults.

artifact_type.description: The type of artifact or work (e.g., 'carvings', 'paintings', 'sculptures') to narrow down the search.

tools.name: city_area_calculator
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to calculate and convert the area of cities into various units, providing detailed geographical data and supporting complex queries related to city statistics and demographics.

city_name.description: The name of the city for which to calculate the area.

unit.description: The unit of area to return. Options include 'square_km', 'square_miles', 'million_square_km', 'hectares', 'acres', 'square_feet'. Default is 'million_square_km'.

include_water_area.description: Whether to include water bodies within the city boundaries in the area calculation. Default is false.

population_density.description: Whether to include population density data in the output. Default is false.

historical_area_changes.description: Whether to include historical changes in the city's area over time. Default is false.

tools.name: biodiversity_database
tools.description: A tool designed to access biodiversity data, providing species counts and additional ecological information for specific ecosystems or regions, such as rainforests, deserts, or marine environments. Enhanced with additional parameters for more detailed data retrieval.

ecosystem.description: The name of the ecosystem or region to retrieve species data for (e.g., 'Congolian rainforest').

species_type.description: Filter for specific types of species (e.g., 'plants', 'animals', 'fungi'). Optional.

conservation_status.description: Filter species by their conservation status (e.g., 'endangered', 'vulnerable'). Optional.

include_subspecies.description: Whether to include subspecies in the species count. Default is true.

data_source.description: The source of the biodiversity data, which could be a specific database or scientific organization. Optional.

geographic_coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates for more precise location data. Optional.

time_period.description: Temporal filter for data over specific time periods. Optional.

start_date.description: Start date for the data retrieval period.

end_date.description: End date for the data retrieval period.

climate_data.description: Include climate data related to the ecosystem. Optional.

human_impact.description: Include data on human impact factors in the ecosystem. Optional.

tools.name: biographical_info_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve detailed biographical information about individuals, including birthplaces, birth dates, full biographies, and other relevant personal details, from a comprehensive database of notable figures. It supports multiple languages and provides options for including sources and filtering results.

person_name.description: The full name of the individual whose biographical information is being requested.

info_type.description: The specific type of biographical information requested. Options include 'birthplace', 'birthdate', 'full_bio', 'career', 'achievements'. Default is 'birthplace'.

language.description: The language in which the information should be returned. Default is 'English'.

include_sources.description: Whether to include sources or references for the retrieved information. Default is false.

date_range.description: The date range for filtering biographical events. Useful for retrieving information about specific periods in an individual's life.

start_date.description: The start date for the date range filter.

end_date.description: The end date for the date range filter.

tools.name: capital_city_lookup
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to provide the capital city of specified countries, along with additional information such as population, area, and timezone, utilizing a comprehensive database of countries and their capitals.

country.description: The name of the country for which to find the capital city.

countries.description: A list of country names for which to find the capital cities.

include_population.description: Whether to include the population of the capital city in the response.

include_area.description: Whether to include the area of the capital city in the response.

include_timezone.description: Whether to include the timezone of the capital city in the response.

country_code.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code of the country for which to find the capital city.

tools.name: architectural_designer_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify the designers or architects of specific architectural or urban features, providing detailed information about their work, background, and additional attributes.

structure_name.description: The name of the architectural or urban feature to find the designer for.

location.description: The location of the structure, which can help narrow down the search results.

year_built.description: The year the structure was built or completed, which can help refine the search.

designer_type.description: The type of designer to search for, such as 'architect', 'landscape architect', or 'urban planner'.

include_firm.description: Whether to include the architectural firm or company associated with the designer. Default is true.

style.description: The architectural style of the structure, which can help refine the search.

materials_used.description: A list of primary materials used in the construction of the structure.

notable_awards.description: Whether to include information about notable awards received by the designer or the structure. Default is false.

tools.name: innovation_country_identifier
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to identify and rank countries based on their innovation and contributions in specific industries, such as electronics, by analyzing various metrics and indices. The tool allows for detailed customization through advanced parameters.

sector.description: The industry or sector to evaluate for innovation. Examples include 'electronics', 'biotechnology', 'automotive', 'software', 'renewable_energy'.

metrics.description: The metrics to consider for evaluating innovation, such as 'R&D spending', 'patents', 'global innovation index'.

year.description: The year for which the innovation data should be considered. If not specified, the latest available data will be used.

top_n.description: The number of top countries to return based on innovation ranking. Default is 5.

region.description: The geographical region to focus on for the innovation analysis. Examples include 'Asia', 'Europe', 'North America'.

data_sources.description: The data sources to be used for the analysis. Examples include 'World Bank', 'OECD', 'WIPO'.

metric_weights.description: Weights assigned to each metric to customize their impact on the overall innovation ranking.

tools.name: satellite_info_retriever
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve comprehensive information about satellites, including weight, launch details, specifications, orbit type, operational status, and payload details, from an extensive database of satellite launches.

agency.description: The name of the space agency responsible for the satellite launch (e.g., 'JAXA', 'NASA').

satellite_name.description: The name of the satellite for which information is being requested.

launch_date.description: The date of the satellite launch in YYYY-MM-DD format. Optional, but can help narrow down results.

weight_unit.description: The unit of weight to return. Options include 'kg' and 'lbs'. Default is 'kg'.

mission_type.description: The type of mission the satellite is involved in (e.g., 'communication', 'research', 'navigation'). Optional.

orbit_type.description: The type of orbit the satellite is in (e.g., 'LEO', 'GEO', 'MEO'). Optional.

operational_status.description: The current operational status of the satellite (e.g., 'active', 'inactive', 'decommissioned'). Optional.

payload_details.description: Details about the payload carried by the satellite. Optional.

tools.name: sports_venue_info
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to provide detailed information about sports venues, including their capacity, location, types of events hosted, and additional features. It supports queries for various types of sports facilities and can filter results based on specific criteria.

location.description: The geographic area or city where the sports venue is located, e.g., 'Silicon Valley'.

venue_name.description: The name of the sports venue to get specific information about. Optional if searching by location.

sport_type.description: The types of sports the venue is primarily used for. Can include multiple sports. Optional.

include_events.description: Whether to include information about events hosted at the venue. Default is false.

seating_capacity.description: The seating capacity of the venue. Optional.

accessibility_features.description: Accessibility features available at the venue. Optional.

historical_significance.description: Whether the venue has historical significance. Default is false.

tools.name: academic_paper_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to search for academic papers and publications based on specific topics, keywords, or authors, providing detailed bibliographic information and filtering options.

topic.description: The main topic or keywords to search for in academic papers.

author.description: The name of the author to filter the search results. Optional.

publication_date.description: The publication date or range to filter results (e.g., '2020', '2015-2020'). Optional.

journal.description: The name of the journal to limit the search to specific publications. Optional.

database.description: The academic database to search within (e.g., 'PubMed', 'Google Scholar'). Optional.

publication_type.description: The type of publication to filter results (e.g., 'journal article', 'conference paper'). Optional.

language.description: The language of the publication to filter results. Optional.

tools.name: organization_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify organizations based on their type, geographic location, and additional criteria, providing detailed information about the organization such as name, abbreviation, primary functions, size, and founding year.

organization_type.description: The type of organization to search for (e.g., 'space agency', 'university', 'government agency').

country.description: The country where the organization is located.

city.description: The city where the organization is located. Optional parameter for more precise location filtering.

region.description: The region or state where the organization is located. Optional parameter for more precise location filtering.

include_details.description: Whether to include additional details about the organization such as abbreviation and primary functions. Default is false.

organization_size.description: The size of the organization (e.g., 'small', 'medium', 'large'). Optional parameter for filtering based on organization size.

founding_year.description: The year the organization was founded. Optional parameter for filtering based on founding year.

detail_level.description: The level of detail required in the output (e.g., 'basic', 'detailed', 'comprehensive'). Default is 'detailed'.

tools.name: research_location_identifier
tools.description: A tool designed to identify specific locations or sites associated with the research or work of notable individuals, providing historical and biographical context. It now includes enhanced parameters for greater specificity and utility.

individual.description: The name of the individual whose research location is being queried.

field_of_research.description: The field of research or study associated with the individual (e.g., 'primatology', 'conservation'). Optional.

include_multiple_locations.description: Whether to include multiple locations if the individual has worked in more than one place. Default is false.

historical_period.description: The time period during which the research was conducted. Optional.

geographical_region.description: The geographical region or country where the research was conducted. Optional.

specific_events.description: Specific events or collaborations associated with the research. Optional.

tools.name: biographical_residence_locator
tools.description: A tool designed to identify past residences of historical figures, providing detailed information on where individuals lived during different periods of their lives, with enhanced options for specificity and context.

individual_name.description: The name of the individual whose residential history is being queried.

time_period.description: The specific time period for which the residence information is sought. Optional, but can help narrow down results.

include_all_residences.description: Whether to include all known residences throughout the individual's life. Default is true.

include_historical_context.description: Whether to include historical context or notable events related to the residences. Default is false.

residence_type.description: The type of residence to query, such as primary, secondary, or temporary. Optional.

geographical_region.description: The geographical region to focus on for the residence query. Optional.

information_source.description: The source of the residence information, such as historical records, biographies, or personal letters. Optional.

cultural_political_context.description: Whether to include cultural or political events related to the residences. Default is false.

tools.name: historical_term_origin_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify the origin of historical terms and the individuals associated with them, providing context and background information from historical records and documents.

term.description: The historical term or phrase to search for its origin and associated individual.

include_context.description: Whether to include contextual information about the term's origin, such as the event or speech where it was first used. Default is true.

time_period.description: The time period to focus the search on, which can help narrow down results. Accepts specific years, ranges (e.g., '1800-1850'), or eras (e.g., 'Renaissance'). Optional.

region.description: The region or country associated with the term, which can help refine the search. Accepts multiple regions separated by commas. Optional.

source_type.description: The type of source material to prioritize in the search, such as 'books', 'letters', 'newspapers', or 'all'. Default is 'all'.

detail_level.description: The level of detail required in the results, such as 'summary', 'detailed', or 'comprehensive'. Default is 'summary'.

tools.name: coral_reef_info_finder
tools.description: A tool designed to identify coral reefs based on specific attributes such as biodiversity, location, ecological significance, and additional environmental factors, providing detailed information about each reef.

attribute.description: The specific attribute to search for in coral reefs, such as 'biodiversity', 'size', or 'conservation status'.

region.description: The geographic region or ocean where the search should be focused (e.g., 'Great Barrier Reef', 'Caribbean Sea'). Optional.

conservation_status.description: Filter reefs by their conservation status (e.g., 'protected', 'endangered'). Optional.

include_remote.description: Whether to include reefs in remote or less-documented areas. Default is true.

reef_size.description: The size category of the reef (e.g., 'small', 'medium', 'large'). Optional.

depth.description: The depth at which the reef is located, measured in meters. Optional.

water_temperature.description: The average water temperature around the reef, measured in degrees Celsius. Optional.

human_impact_level.description: The level of human impact on the reef (e.g., 'low', 'moderate', 'high'). Optional.

tools.name: museum_visitor_statistics
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve detailed visitor statistics for museums, offering annual, quarterly, and monthly visitor counts. It supports complex queries for historical data, comparisons across different museums, and includes filters for visitor demographics and event-specific data.

museum_name.description: The name of the museum for which to retrieve visitor statistics.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve visitor statistics. If not specified, the most recent data is returned.

month.description: The month for which to retrieve visitor statistics. If not specified, annual data is returned.

quarter.description: The quarter for which to retrieve visitor statistics. If not specified, annual data is returned.

compare_years.description: Whether to compare visitor statistics across multiple years. Default is false.

compare_museums.description: Whether to compare visitor statistics across multiple museums. Default is false.

region.description: The region or country where the museum is located. This can help narrow down results if multiple museums have similar names.

include_historical_data.description: Whether to include historical visitor data in the results. Default is false.

visitor_demographics.description: Whether to include visitor demographic data in the results. Default is false.

event_specific_data.description: Whether to include data specific to events held at the museum. Default is false.

tools.name: biodiversity_database
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to provide detailed information on species diversity within specific ecological regions, such as the Great Barrier Reef, offering data on species counts, types, conservation status, and temporal changes.

region.description: The name of the ecological region or area to query for species information.

species_type.description: Filter for specific types of species (e.g., 'marine', 'coral', 'fish', 'invertebrates'). Optional.

conservation_status.description: Filter species by their conservation status (e.g., 'endangered', 'vulnerable', 'least concern'). Optional.

include_subspecies.description: Whether to include subspecies in the species count. Default is false.

data_source.description: The source of the biodiversity data, which could be a specific database or research institution. Optional.

temporal_range.description: Specify the time range for the data, allowing for analysis of changes over time. Optional.

start_year.description: The starting year for the data range.

end_year.description: The ending year for the data range.

coordinates.description: Geographical coordinates to specify a more precise location within the region. Optional.

habitat_type.description: Filter species by their habitat type (e.g., 'reef', 'forest', 'wetland'). Optional.

ecological_role.description: Filter species by their ecological role (e.g., 'predator', 'prey', 'decomposer'). Optional.

tools.name: vineyard_region_identifier
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to identify and analyze regions famous for vineyards and wine production. It provides detailed information on viticulture areas globally, with advanced filtering options by wine type, grape variety, climate, soil type, and production volume.

region_name.description: The name of the region to search for its association with vineyards. Optional for broader searches.

country.description: The country where the search should be focused. This can help narrow down results.

wine_type.description: Filter for specific types of wine produced in the region (e.g., 'red', 'white', 'sparkling'). Optional.

grape_variety.description: Filter for specific grape varieties associated with the region. Optional.

historical_significance.description: Whether to consider regions with historical significance in viticulture. Default is false.

climate.description: The climate of the region, which can affect grape growing conditions. Optional.

soil_type.description: The predominant soil type in the region, influencing grape quality. Optional.

production_volume.description: The annual production volume of wine in the region, measured in hectoliters. Optional.

tools.name: historical_figure_info
tools.description: A tool designed to provide detailed biographical information about historical figures, including birthplaces, birthdates, major achievements, and other significant life events.

figure_name.description: The name of the historical figure to retrieve information about.

info_type.description: The type of information requested about the historical figure. Options include 'birthplace', 'birthdate', 'major_achievements', 'deathdate', 'influences', 'legacy'.

additional_context.description: Whether to provide additional context or related historical information. Default is false.

time_period.description: The specific time period during which the historical figure was active or influential. This can help narrow down the context of the information provided.

geographical_region.description: The geographical region associated with the historical figure, which can provide more localized context.

specific_events.description: A list of specific events or contributions associated with the historical figure.

tools.name: museum_locator
tools.description: A comprehensive tool designed to identify museums located within a specified city or region, providing results based on location and a variety of filtering options to enhance user experience.

city.description: The name of the city where the search for museums should be conducted.

museum_type.description: Filter for specific types of museums (e.g., 'art', 'history', 'science'). Optional.

popularity.description: Filter based on the popularity or visitor ratings of the museums. Options include 'high', 'medium', 'low'. Optional.

include_free_entry.description: Whether to include museums with free entry in the search. Default is false.

opening_hours.description: Filter museums based on their opening hours. Format: 'HH:MM-HH:MM'. Optional.

accessibility_features.description: List of required accessibility features (e.g., 'wheelchair_access', 'audio_guides'). Optional.

user_reviews.description: Filter based on user reviews. Optional.

minimum_rating.description: Minimum average rating required. Range: 1.0 to 5.0.

tools.name: invention_inventor_lookup
tools.description: An advanced tool designed to retrieve detailed information about the inventors of various technologies and inventions, offering comprehensive historical context, handling queries related to invention history, and providing additional filtering options.

invention.description: The name of the invention for which the inventor information is sought.

include_context.description: Whether to include additional historical context or related information about the invention. Default is false.

disputed_claims.description: Whether to include information about disputed claims of invention. Default is false.

time_period.description: The specific time period for which the invention information is sought, formatted as 'YYYY-YYYY'.

inventor_nationality.description: Filter results by the nationality of the inventor.

include_patent_info.description: Whether to include patent information related to the invention. Default is false.

tools.name: advanced_arithmetic_calculator
tools.description: An enhanced arithmetic calculator designed to perform basic and advanced arithmetic operations, including addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulus, exponentiation, and root extraction, on integers, floating-point numbers, and complex numbers.

operation.description: The arithmetic operation to perform. Options include 'add', 'subtract', 'multiply', 'divide', 'modulus', 'exponentiate', 'root'.

operands.description: An array of numbers on which the operation will be performed. Supports integers, floating-point numbers, and complex numbers.

precision.description: The number of decimal places to round the result to. Defaults to 2 if not specified.

error_handling.description: Defines the behavior in case of errors such as division by zero. Options include 'ignore', 'warn', 'strict'.

tools.name: climate_data_retriever
tools.description: A tool designed to retrieve climatological data, such as average annual rainfall, temperature, and humidity, for various locations worldwide. It provides access to historical and current climate data, supporting different geographic scales and time frames.

location.description: The name of the location for which to retrieve climate data.

data_type.description: The type of climate data to retrieve, such as 'rainfall', 'temperature', or 'humidity'.

time_frame.description: The time frame for the climate data, such as 'monthly' or 'annual'. Default is 'annual'.

unit.description: The unit for the climate data. For rainfall, options include 'millimeters' or 'inches'. Default is 'millimeters'.

start_year.description: The start year for historical data retrieval. Optional.

end_year.description: The end year for historical data retrieval. Optional.
